PU_MultiElimAllAndBoss_DC_Stanton_microT.title: Secure Bounty: ~mission(TargetName) (VHRT)
PU_MultiElimAllAndBoss_DC_Stanton_microT.description:
ABOUT THE JOB
microTech Protection Services is looking for a qualified bounty hunter to apprehend ~mission(TargetName) who has so far been able to evade capture. They are coordinating an active raid that has spread throughout ~mission(Location|Address).  

Our hope is that you may be able to finally draw them out of hiding if you confront their forces at several different attack points. With their numbers sufficiently weakened, ~mission(TargetName|Last) will most likely risk exposure and you will be able to confront them directly.

RESPONSIBILITIES
• Provide own transportation to ~mission(Location|Address).
•Confront ~mission(TargetName)’s criminal associates to draw the target into the open.
• Neutralize ~mission(TargetName); using force if necessary.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
• Access to combat equipment and mode of transport.
• Available for immediate deployment.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
• Ability to handle high pressure situations.

PU_MultiElimAllAndBoss_DC_Stanton_Sakura.label: PU_MultiElimAllAndBoss_DC_Stanton_Sakurasun-Magnolia
PU_MultiElimAllAndBoss_DC_Stanton_Sakura.title: Evasive Bounty: ~mission(TargetName) (VHRT)
PU_MultiElimAllAndBoss_DC_Stanton_Sakura.description:
HURSTON DYNAMICS OUTSOURCING
CONTRACT: Bounty Collection
OUTSOURCE MANAGER: I. Takao
RISK ASSESSMENT: Very High Risk Target (Armed Support)

Hurston Dynamics is seeking a contractor to complete a bounty for ~mission(TargetName). This target and the large hostile force they are traveling with have just been reported raiding ~mission(Location|Address). 

However, if their MO holds true, ~mission(TargetName|Last) has typically remained hidden during attacks, preferring to direct their forces from afar. It is our recommendation that you focus on thinning out their allies first, and once their numbers have been significantly weakened, ~mission(TargetName|Last) will have no choice but to confront you directly. 

Payment will be released only after the bounty has been deemed complete.




** The information transmitted may contain confidential and/or privileged material. Any review, retransmission, dissemination or other use of or taking action in reliance upon this information by persons or entities other than the intended recipient is prohibited. **

PU_Recover_PVE_Stanton3_Lawful_Intro.description:
ATTN: Mercs / Bounty Hunters with Cargo Handling Experience

We just got word that a thief by the name of ~mission(TargetName) is flying around with their most recent score aboard their ship.

Normally, we'd have someone arrest the bastard and be done with it, but right now the most important thing is that the stolen goods are recovered. 

If this sounds like your kind of thing, you will be authorized to track down ~mission(TargetName|Last), secure the stolen ~mission(Item) however you can, and deliver it to ~mission(Destination|Address). ~mission(Contractor|RecoverSpaceTimed)~mission(Danger)


Thanks,
Gloria Mesa

Private Contract Supervisor
BlacJac Security, "Protection Provided"

PU_Delivery_Local_DerelictOutposts_Deliv.label: PU_Delivery_Local_DerelictOutposts_Deliver1_Stanton1
PU_Delivery_Local_DerelictOutposts_Deliv.title: Retrieval Op
PU_Delivery_Local_DerelictOutposts_Deliv.description:
Here's the deal – a client of ours (who should have spent the extra credits for a Northrock escort) had one of their ships attacked and now they need us to run point on a retrieval op for an important package that was stolen.

Thankfully, we caught a break and were able to track down the people responsible to <EM4>~mission(Pickup1|Address)</EM4>. We need you to head there and recover the package. You'll be able to ID it by its serial number: <EM4>#~mission(Item1|SerialNumber)</EM4>.

I expect that the outlaws are going to put up a fight, but just remember that they aren't the priority.

Once you got the package, fly it back to the client at <EM4>~mission(Dropoff1|Address)</EM4>. 

One last thing, make sure you bring a ship that has enough room for some cargo. Don't want you getting all the way there in your Gladius or whatever only to have to turn back.

Do us proud,

Braden Corchado
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group

*RETRIEVAL OPERATION SUMMARY*
* Recover Package <EM4>#~mission(Item1|SerialNumber)</EM4> from <EM4>~mission(Pickup1|Address)</EM4>
* Deliver to <EM4>~mission(Dropoff1|Address)</EM4>

PU_EliminateBoss_Lawful_Standard.description:
Hey, 

Have an interesting bounty for you. A high level criminal by the name ~mission(TargetName) has been located at ~mission(Location|Address). 

Based on our intel, its highly unlikely that the target’s going to be sitting and waiting out in the open. You most likely will have to infiltrate the facility and draw them out. 

Something like a large firefight should be enough to do the trick. 

Best of luck,

Braden Corchado
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group

PU_EliminateBoss_Unlawful_NoNonHostiles.label: PU_EliminateBoss_Unlawful_NoNonHostiles
PU_EliminateBoss_Unlawful_NoNonHostiles.title: They Will Be Missed
PU_EliminateBoss_Unlawful_NoNonHostiles.description:
A senior security official by the name of ~mission(TargetName) has been marked for termination. While they can be found at ~mission(Location|Address), they will not be easy to get to. I fear that a bit of work will be required to draw them out.  

Normally, I would recommend killing enough of their underlings that they will be forced to face you personally. However, in this instance a more delicate touch is required. While you should feel free to eliminate any and all of the security forces on site, you must ensure the safety of all the civilian workers there.

Tiresome for sure, but a requirement none the less. 

Earnestly,
Vaughn

PU_EliminateBoss_Unlawful_EliminateCompe.label: PU_EliminateBoss_Unlawful_EliminateCompetition
PU_EliminateBoss_Unlawful_EliminateCompe.title: All Things Come To An End
PU_EliminateBoss_Unlawful_EliminateCompe.description:
I am not sure if you’re acquainted with ~mission(Location|Address), but ~mission(TargetName) is the one who calls the shots there. I need them eliminated.

That is easier said then done, I'm afraid. They are notoriously reluctant to see to matters personally, preferring their underlings to handle the dirty work. That said, eliminate enough of the underlings and they will have no choice but to deal with you themselves.

Earnestly,
Vaughn

PU_EliminateBoss_Unlawful_Standard.label: PU_EliminateBoss_Unlawful_Standard
PU_EliminateBoss_Unlawful_Standard.title: They Will Be Missed
PU_EliminateBoss_Unlawful_Standard.description:
A senior security official by the name of ~mission(TargetName) is about to have their long career come to a very violent and sudden end. While they are currently at ~mission(Location|Address), they will not be easy to get to. I fear that a bit of work will be required to draw them out.  

I recommend killing enough of their underlings that they will be forced to face you personally. Of course, once they do decide to finally show their face, it should be a rather straightforward matter. 

Earnestly,
Vaughn

PU_RetrieveConsignment_Stanton2_Illegal.label: PU_RetrieveConsignment_Stanton2_Illegal
PU_RetrieveConsignment_Stanton2_Illegal.title: get the goods
PU_RetrieveConsignment_Stanton2_Illegal.description:
Oh hello, I recently overheard a little bit of intel that ~mission(location|address) received some confidential materials that are of great interest to an acquaintance of mine. So interesting that they’re willing to pay for someone to storm the facility, grab the goods, and deliver them to ~mission(DropOff1|address). Now I expect there to be plenty of security, who will most likely put up a fight, so I’d bring a gun or two. 

Word is the confidential materials were delivered in a consignment alongside other stuff and are now being stored in the facility’s automated vault. Senior security officers on-site carry datapads containing retrieval codes used to access the vault. You’ll have to get your hands on a datapad before using the package conveyor to retrieve the boxes. 

If you need a little sweetener, I’ve seen the manifest and can confirm that the other crates being stored at the facility are pretty choice. My client could care less about what happens to them, so they’re yours to do as you please. Run this right and those extra crates could be a nice bonus on top of the delivery fee for you.

PU_RetrieveConsignment_Stanton2_Legal.label: PU_RetrieveConsignment_Stanton2_Legal
PU_RetrieveConsignment_Stanton2_Legal.title: Support Security Forces and Secure Confidential Materials
PU_RetrieveConsignment_Stanton2_Legal.description:
Reports indicate that our security staff at ~mission(location|address) have been wiped out by a group of Nine Tails, who are attempting to steal confidential materials that were recently delivered to the facility. Crusader Security needs an experienced contractor to expel the hostiles and secure these boxes. 

Based on the initial reports, we strongly recommend that you come well-equipped and consider bringing back-up. For security purposes, the confidential materials were transported there as part of a consignment with other boxes and locked in an automated vault. The retrieval codes to access the confidential materials are stored on datapads held by high-ranking security staff, but we don’t know who has them now. Odds are that the Nine Tails will be looking for them too.  

When you have all the confidential materials, deliver them to ~mission(dropoff1|address) to receive payment. 

CONTRACT AUTHORIZED BY: 
Liaison Officer Bautista 
ID# 948J030K

PU_RetrieveConsignment_Stanton4_Legal.label: PU_RetrieveConsignment_Stanton4_Legal
PU_RetrieveConsignment_Stanton4_Legal.title: Defend Location and Deliver Confidential Materials
PU_RetrieveConsignment_Stanton4_Legal.description:
ABOUT THE JOB
microTech Protection Services need a security professional for a retrieval op at ~mission(Location). The location is currently under attack and security forces on-site are unresponsive and presumed dead. We believe confidential materials recently delivered to the facility for temporary holding were the target of the raid. Your main focus will be collecting those boxes and delivering them to a secure location.  

For security reasons, the confidential materials were delivered as part of a larger shipment and secured in the automated vault. The materials have unique retrieval codes that must be entered on the keypad at the package conveyor. Protocols require that only senior security officers can carry a datapad containing a code, but considering the volatile situation, we can't guarantee that the Nine Tails haven’t taken possession of them. Once secured, deliver all of the confidential materials to ~mission(dropoff1) for payment.

RESPONSIBILITIES
• Provide own transportation to ~mission(Location|address).
• Use force as necessary to collect the confidential materials.
• Deliver the confidential materials to ~mission(dropoff1|address).

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
• 2 years of combined mercenary and/or security experience.
• Access to combat equipment. 
• Access to a spaceship that can transport cargo.
• Available for immediate deployment.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
• Experience with rapid hostility de-escalation techniques.
• Experience hauling important cargo.

PU_RetrieveConsignment_Stanton3_Legal.title: Protect Site and Procure Confidential Materials
PU_RetrieveConsignment_Stanton3_Legal.description:
ATTN: Mercenaries with Cargo Handling Experience

Nine Tails are currently assaulting one of our facilities at ~mission(Location|address). As they just received a delivery of confidential materials, we don’t believe this is a coincidence. BlacJac needs someone to hurry to the location and secure these important boxes before the Nine Tails do. You are authorized to use lethal force against any who attempt to stop you. 

As part of our standard security protocol, the confidential materials were integrated into another consignment and secured in the automated vault. You’ll need to find the relevant retrieval codes for the confidential materials and enter it at the package conveyor to retrieve the boxes. Retrieval codes are stored locally on datapads and only given to high-ranking staff. Hopefully they’re alive to help you, but considering the complete comms blackout, we fear that’s not the case. There's a chance Nine Tails have already gotten their hands on the datapads.  

Once you’ve gathered all the confidential materials, they will need to be delivered to ~mission(dropoff1|address). Payment is contingent upon their delivery.


Thanks,
Gloria Mesa

Private Contract Supervisor
BlacJac Security, "Protection Provided"

PU_RetrieveConsignment_Pyro_CFP.label: PU_RetrieveConsignment_Pyro_CFP
PU_RetrieveConsignment_Pyro_CFP.title: Confidential Material Stolen
PU_RetrieveConsignment_Pyro_CFP.description:
You available for a job? One of our secure locations got hit by outlaws and some highly confidential material was stolen. As you can imagine, Citizens for Prosperity is eager to recover them as soon as possible.

Thanks to a local contact, we were able to trace the outlaws back to ~mission(Location|Address) where they're storing the confidential materials inside a secure automated vault. To access it, you’ll need to first find the relevant retrieval code and enter it at the vault’s package conveyor. Our best guess is that one of outlaw leaders will be carrying the code on their person so there is a very strong chance you’ll have to engage with them directly to get it.
  
Once you’ve gotten possession of the confidential material, we want you to deliver it to ~mission(Dropoff1|Address).

You’ll be making a big difference to a lot of people if you manage to pull this off.

Thanks in advance,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

PU_RetrieveConsignment_Stanton1_Legal.label: PU_RetrieveConsignment_Stanton1_Legal
PU_RetrieveConsignment_Stanton1_Legal.title: Defend Site and Retrieve Confidential Materials
PU_RetrieveConsignment_Stanton1_Legal.description:
HURSTON DYNAMICS
OUTSOURCING DEPARTMENT

CONTRACT: Facility Sweep & Package Retrieval
CONTRACTOR AFFILIATION: Independent
OUTSOURCE MANAGER: G. Livingston
RISK ASSESSMENT: High
RUSH CONTRACT: Yes

Hurston has learned that the Nine Tails are attacking ~mission(Location|address). Our on-site forces have suffered heavy casualties and stopped responding to comms. Initial reports indicated that the gang was attempting to obtain confidential material recently delivered to the facility. Thankfully, we have security measures in place that should give us time to respond. We need an operative to head to the facility immediately, retrieve those boxes, and deliver them to a secure location.

You and whatever backup you choose to bring are authorized to take any actions necessary when confronting the trespassers. Suspects are considered armed and dangerous. Hurston will not provide material support and/or updates regarding the status of the facility's security forces. 

The confidential materials were discreetly delivered alongside other boxes in a consignment and locked in our automated vault with access codes kept on datapads held by senior security staff. However, there’s a strong chance Nine Tails may already have gotten their hands on them. You’ll need to find those datapads and then enter the codes at the package conveyor to retrieve the confidential materials. Payment will be sent once they have been delivered to ~mission(dropoff1|address). 


** The information transmitted may contain confidential and/or privileged material. Any review, retransmission, dissemination, or other use of or taking action in reliance upon this information by persons or entities other than the intended recipient is prohibited. **

HexPenetrator_Comm_3.label: HexPenetrator_Comm_3
HexPenetrator_Comm_3.title: Overdrive Initiative: XENOTHREAT SURVEILLANCE
HexPenetrator_Comm_3.description:
One of the suspects captured during the recent attacks revealed that XenoThreat is looking to remotely access a number of comm arrays around the system.

Having XenoThreat listening into comms is extremely dangerous for the people living here, so the CDF has been enlisted to reset the comm array, then defend it from any XenoThreat Vanguards that will attempt to reconnect to the servers. 

Once those Vanguards have been defeated, clear out any remaining hostile ships in the area.

As a reminder, the military has generously donated some old F7A Hornets for CDF members who see this initiative through to the end.

The CDF is dispatching volunteers to infiltrate and obtain any intel that could give insight into what they're planning. Needless to say, expect heavy resistance from any XenoThreat on site.

As an added incentive, the military has generously donated some old F7A Hornets for CDF members who see this initiative through to the end.

PU_Delivery_Local_Illegal_Intro.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

I know you've done some solid work for us in the past, so I figured I'd see if you were interested in handling a bit of a special run for us that's a bit farther out in the system than what you've been doing so far.

In a nutshell, we need a pilot who's willing to keep their head down, focus on getting the packages delivered, and most importantly, not ask a lot of questions.

See, for a smaller company like us, staying ahead of competition means that we need to offer our clients something they can't get elsewhere - discretion. At Red Wind, as long as you got the credits we'll take whatever to wherever. Understand?

If that sounds good to you, let's see how you do on this run -

PACKAGES FOR PICK UP (ANY ORDER)
     · Package <EM4>#~mission(Item1|SerialNumber)</EM4> from the <EM4>~mission(Pickup1|Address)</EM4>
     · Package <EM4>#~mission(Item2|SerialNumber)</EM4> from the <EM4>~mission(Pickup2|Address)</EM4>
     · Package <EM4>#~mission(Item3|SerialNumber)</EM4> from the <EM4>~mission(Pickup3|Address)</EM4>

DROP OFF LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)
     · Package <EM4>#~mission(Item1|SerialNumber)</EM4> to the <EM4>~mission(Dropoff1|Address)</EM4>
     · Package <EM4>#~mission(Item2|SerialNumber)</EM4> to the <EM4>~mission(Dropoff2|Address)</EM4>
     · Package <EM4>#~mission(Item3|SerialNumber)</EM4> to the <EM4>~mission(Dropoff3|Address)</EM4>

One last bit of advice, it would probably be good to avoid any unnecessary delays once you got the packages onboard, for example being searched by local law enforcement.

PU_EliminateSpecific_Unlawful_EliminateC.title: All Things Come To An End
PU_EliminateSpecific_Unlawful_EliminateC.description:
They say there is no honor among thieves. Today, it seems, you're targeting one of your own. 

Please head to ~mission(Location|Address) and kill ~mission(TargetName). What you do with the others there is entirely up to you.

Earnestly,
Vaughn

PU_EliminateSpecific_Unlawful_Standard.label: PU_EliminateSpecific_Unlawful_Standard
PU_EliminateSpecific_Unlawful_Standard.title: They Will Be Missed
PU_EliminateSpecific_Unlawful_Standard.description:
A security officer by the name of ~mission(TargetName) is in desperate need of an early retirement. They are currently stationed at ~mission(Location|Address) along with a host of other eager types in uniforms. 

Feel free to indulge your violent whims, but it is only the death of ~mission(TargetName) which will earn you my credit and thanks.

Earnestly,
Vaughn

PU_EliminateAll_Caves_Pyro3.label: PU_EliminateAll_Caves_Pyro3
PU_EliminateAll_Caves_Pyro3.title: A Swift Reprisal
PU_EliminateAll_Caves_Pyro3.description:
Hey,

Some two-bit thugs are holed up in ~mission(Location|Address). Wouldn’t pay them any mind, except the arrogant skags tried to hit an outpost under our protection.

We chased 'em off with little trouble, but we can't let that kind of disrespect go unpunished. Our Clips are busy with some bigger fish, so we'd like you to take care of this for us. 

Stows out.

PU_Multi-EliminateBoss_Modular_4Location.label: PU_Multi-EliminateBoss_Modular_4Locations_FloatingPlatform
PU_Multi-EliminateBoss_Modular_4Location.title: Nine Tails Enforcer Bounties (VHRT)
PU_Multi-EliminateBoss_Modular_4Location.description:
Crusader Security has received intelligence that a Nine Tails raid currently occurring at ~mission(MissionCluster|Address) includes several prominent gang enforcers. Ending this raid and bringing those responsible to justice is a top priority for Crusader Security. That's why we're looking for a contractor willing to go and apprehend those leading it.

At each attack site, you will need to deplete the Nine Tails forces there until you are able to draw out the enforcer in charge.

Considering the brutality deployed by Nine Tails during their recent siege, we recommend that contractors be prepared to use force and strongly encourage them to consider bringing back-up.

CONTRACT AUTHORIZED BY:
Liaison Officer Gibbs
ID# 91G66BW0

PU_SalvageContractor_PvP_Pyro_HH.label: PU_SalvageContractor_PvP_Pyro_HH
PU_SalvageContractor_PvP_Pyro_HH.title: In the Wake of Disaster
PU_SalvageContractor_PvP_Pyro_HH.description:
Fortune has shined upon us once again. I’ve just learned of a battle near ~mission(Location) that’s just transpired far from the prying eyes of any meddlesome comm arrays, and reinforcements from either of the forces involved have yet to be dispatched. This means that there is a window of opportunity for an enterprising soul to pick the graveyard clean.
 
I’d like to extend this opportunity to all my trusted contacts. Any and all interested parties can have the location… for the right price. Coordinates will be provided once you accept the contract and will remain available until you choose to terminate it.

Of course, speed will be of the essence as you will not only face potential competition from other salvagers, but also the looming possibility of reinforcements arriving to survey the battlefield. 

If you’re still hesitating, just remember, fortune favors the bold.

-cd

PU_SalvageContractor_Coverup_Stanton2_Me.label: PU_SalvageContractor_Coverup_Stanton2_Medium
PU_SalvageContractor_Coverup_Stanton2_Me.title: ~mission(ship) clean up
PU_SalvageContractor_Coverup_Stanton2_Me.description:
Got a particular salvage job that we could use some extra hands on. 

We need you to find a ~mission(ship) that got punched out around ~mission(location). Security’s already searching for it and if they find it, they’ll ID it for sure and we’ll be in loads of trouble.

So, we want you to make sure that can’t happen. Either tow the ship out of the search area or rip the entire hull off so nobody can tell who it belonged to. Whatever you decide, keep your mouth shut about this. 

We’ll cred you up and anything you scrap is yours to keep. But if security finds the ship before you’re done, we’ll all be screwed and you won’t get paid so don’t disappoint.

PU_Inhabited_Derelict_Recover_Stash_Lawf.label: PU_Inhabited_Derelict_Recover_Stash_Lawful_Stanton1
PU_Inhabited_Derelict_Recover_Stash_Lawf.title: Retrieval Op
PU_Inhabited_Derelict_Recover_Stash_Lawf.description:
Here's the deal – a client of ours (who should have spent the extra credits for a Northrock escort) had one of their ships attacked and now they need us to run point on a retrieval op for an important package that was stolen.

Thankfully, we caught a break and were able to track down the people responsible to <EM4>~mission(Pickup1|Address)</EM4>. We need you to head there and recover the package. You'll be able to ID it by its serial number: <EM4>#~mission(Item1|SerialNumber)</EM4>.

I expect that the outlaws are going to put up a fight, but just remember that they aren't the priority.

Once you got the package, fly it back to the client at <EM4>~mission(Dropoff1|Address)</EM4>. 

One last thing, make sure you bring a ship that has enough room for some cargo. Don't want you getting all the way there in your Gladius or whatever only to have to turn back.

Do us proud,

Braden Corchado
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group

*RETRIEVAL OPERATION SUMMARY*
* Recover Package <EM4>#~mission(Item1|SerialNumber)</EM4> from <EM4>~mission(Pickup1|Address)</EM4>
* Deliver to <EM4>~mission(Dropoff1|Address)</EM4>

PU_DestroyNarcotics_Illegal_Stanton1.description:
One of my clients has been unhappy to learn that someone's been muscling in on their territory. Now rather than going down the more traditional route of killing some people and starting a whole thing, they’ve opted to send a different kind of message instead.

You’re gonna go down to ~mission(Location|Address) and destroy all the drugs on site. 

Of course, if someone does wanna pick a fight with you, feel free to defend yourself, but getting rid of the product is the most important thing.

PU_DestroyNarcotics_Legal_Stanton2.label: PU_DestroyNarcotics_Legal_Stanton2
PU_DestroyNarcotics_Legal_Stanton2.title: Destroy Toxic Narcotics
PU_DestroyNarcotics_Legal_Stanton2.description:
We’ve been investigating a recent bout of OD’s and they all seem to have originated with a bad batch of drugs made over at ~mission(Location|Address). 

I’m working with other contractors to ferret out those responsible, but people are dying as long is the product is still out there. 

I want you to go the site and destroy the stash they have there. Should buy us some time before we shut them down for good.

They will have guards protecting their supply, so be prepared to engage with hostiles.

CONTRACT AUTHORIZED BY:
Liaison Officer Bautista
ID# 948J030K

PU_DestroyNarcotics_Legal_Stanton1.label: PU_DestroyNarcotics_Legal_Stanton1
PU_DestroyNarcotics_Legal_Stanton1.title: Eliminate Drug Stash
PU_DestroyNarcotics_Legal_Stanton1.description:
HURSTON DYNAMICS
OUTSOURCING DEPARTMENT

CONTRACT: Contraband Elimination
CONTRACTOR AFFILIATION: Independent
OUTSOURCE MANAGER: R. Russel
RISK ASSESSMENT: High
RUSH CONTRACT: No

Local criminals have been identified using ~mission(Location|Address) to manufacture large quantities of illegal. Hurston Security requires a contractor to go to the facility and eliminate all contraband being stored there.

Payment will be sent once all the contraband is eliminated. 



** The information transmitted may contain confidential and/or privileged material. Any review, retransmission, dissemination, or other use of or taking action in reliance upon this information by persons or entities other than the intended recipient is prohibited. **

PU_DestroyNarcotics_Legal_Stanton3.label: PU_DestroyNarcotics_Legal_Stanton3
PU_DestroyNarcotics_Legal_Stanton3.title: Clear Out Drugs
PU_DestroyNarcotics_Legal_Stanton3.description:
ATTN: Verified Mercenary Operators

We got word that a syndicate spiked a rival’s drug package and its causing chaos on the streets. Forensics have identified the source, a production facility over at ~mission(Location|Address). Word is the drug manufacturers don’t even know they have a poisoned crop on their hands.

We’re sorting through how to handle the arrests, but the important thing is to get this crap off the streets now. I need you to get down there and destroy the drugs they’re storing on site.

They won’t be happy about it, so you’ll probably have a fight on your hands, but the important thing is clearing out the product.

Thanks,
Gloria Mesa

Private Contract Supervisor
BlacJac Security, "Protection Provided"

PU_DestroyNarcotics_Legal_Stanton4.label: PU_DestroyNarcotics_Legal_Stanton4
PU_DestroyNarcotics_Legal_Stanton4.title: Clear Site of Drugs
PU_DestroyNarcotics_Legal_Stanton4.description:
ABOUT THE JOB
microTech Protection Services is looking for a detail-oriented mercenary or security professional to report to ~mission(Location|Address) and destroy the drugs being stored there. 

RESPONSIBILITIES
• Provide own transportation to ~mission(Location|Address).
• Clear the site of drugs; using force as necessary.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
• 2 years of combined mercenary and/or security experience.
• Access to combat equipment and mode of transport.
• Available for immediate deployment.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
• No ongoing addiction issues.

PU_Destroy_BombingRun_Pyro.label: PU_Destroy_BombingRun_Pyro
PU_Destroy_BombingRun_Pyro.title: Fuel to the Fire
PU_Destroy_BombingRun_Pyro.description:
If you’re in the market for some easy credits, I’ve got an offer for you.

See, word on the vine is that ~mission(location|address) is operating as a fuel depot. They must not have gotten the memo that the fuel trade in Pyro belongs to Rough & Ready.

That’s why you’re going to make your way there and destroy their fuel reserves. They should be easy for you to spot. They’re the large yellow storage tanks dotted around the outpost. Watch out though, there are turret emplacements defending the area, so make sure you’re ready to dodge their shots or blow the guns sky high. 

I’ll leave it up to you how you handle the demo. Bombs would be my first choice, but I don’t care much as long as the gig gets done.

- Smokey

HaulCargo_AToB_Stanton1_Intro.label: HaulCargo_AToB_Stanton1_Intro
HaulCargo_AToB_Stanton1_Intro.title: Opportunity for Independent Cargo Hauler
HaulCargo_AToB_Stanton1_Intro.description:
Earning such accolades as 'Imperial Finances' Top 10 Shipping Companies' and 'Delivery Digest's 2945's Most Trusted Transport,' Covalex is busier than ever. And that means more cargo going to more places. That's where you come in.  

Covalex is looking for dependable and industrious pilots to join our expanding family. Do you have access to a ship that can hold <EM4>~mission(MissionMaxSCUSize) cargo containers</EM4>? Can you pass an Advocacy background check if required? Then a universe of opportunity is waiting for you. 

Simply complete an 'Evaluation Trial’ by picking up a shipment of <EM4>~mission(Item)</EM4> from a freight elevator at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> and successfully delivering it to a freight elevator at <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address)</EM4>.

Upon satisfactory completion, you'll be eligible to become part of Covalex Shipping's vast network of independent transport specialists*.

By the way, we strongly encourage contractors to bring a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> along.   


Covalex Shipping  
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'







*Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.

PU_Derelict_DataDownload_Stanton2.title: WIP Counterfeit Stations.
PU_Derelict_DataDownload_Stanton2.description: WIP I have heard you are the right person for this job, so I will cut to the chase. We have located a UEC counterfeiting station at an old wreck site. If you get to the counterfeiting station quickly, you will be able to download the UEC for yourself. They have got some guards defending the wreck site, but I'm sure you'll be able to handle it. Oh and a final heads up. I am not the only person with this information, so expect a fight.

PU_Delivery_Local_TreasureHunt_UnlawfulS.description:

There's one super tiny issue that you should know about. There’s gonna be a crap ton of security down there. But I'm sure it should be fine.

:)

PU_Delivery_Local_TreasureHunt_LawfulCol.label: PU_Delivery_Local_TreasureHunt_LawfulCollect_Stanton2
PU_Delivery_Local_TreasureHunt_LawfulCol.title: Package Delivery for Ling
PU_Delivery_Local_TreasureHunt_LawfulCol.description:
Hey,

We need you to grab a delivery for us over at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> and then take it to <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address)</EM4>.

I was originally going to send my brother Ricki to handle this, but he said the area’s too dangerous. Guess there’s been a bunch of security warnings around there, but as long as you’re careful and bring some guns or whatever, I’m sure you’ll be fine. You probably won’t even run into anything. 

Thanks, 
Conni Ling
Shipment Coordinator
Ling Family Hauling

PU_Delivery_Local_TreasureHunt_LawfulCol.label: PU_Delivery_Local_TreasureHunt_LawfulCollect_Stanton4
PU_Delivery_Local_TreasureHunt_LawfulCol.title: UDM Package Pick Up
PU_Delivery_Local_TreasureHunt_LawfulCol.description:
Greetings Qualified Shipping Partner!

If you’re looking for work as a delivery pilot, we have the perfect opportunity for you! 

A pick up is waiting at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> to be delivered to <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address)</EM4>. Sounds fun, right?

Warning, there have been multiple security alerts flagged in the area. Be sure to bring along some defensive measures so you can stay safe.

If this sounds like something you're interested in, accept this offer right away! 

Looking forward to working with you,

Unified Distribution Management
 -Delivering the Total Package-

PU_Delivery_Local_TreasureHunt_LawfulCol.label: PU_Delivery_Local_TreasureHunt_LawfulCollect_Stanton1
PU_Delivery_Local_TreasureHunt_LawfulCol.title: RED WIND DELIVERY PILOT NEEDED
PU_Delivery_Local_TreasureHunt_LawfulCol.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

Got a shipment waiting to be hauled from <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> to <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address)</EM4>. 

I’ll be up front with you though, this spot doesn’t have the cleanest of reputations. That being said, they still need packages delivered and they got credits, so that’s all square. But if you go in there, there’s a good chance you might run into some trouble.

Don’t take the job if you can’t handle that.



TO ALL VETS - Red Wind appreciates your service to our Empire! Your struggles mean our freedom!

PU_Delivery_Local_TreasureHunt_LawfulCol.label: PU_Delivery_Local_TreasureHunt_LawfulCollect_Stanton3
PU_Delivery_Local_TreasureHunt_LawfulCol.title: Delivery Pilot for Covalex
PU_Delivery_Local_TreasureHunt_LawfulCol.description:
Hello there,

I have a delivery I need taken care of. The order is waiting at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> to be taken to <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address)</EM4>. 

I’m sure you’ll be fine, but for full disclosure, I’m seeing a bunch of security warnings pop up for this area. Seems there have been a handful of attacks in that area in the last few days. Now, I’m not saying you’ll run into anything, but it would probably be best if you brought along a bit of protection.

Good luck,

Chase Hewitt
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping  
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'

PU_EliminateSpecific_Caves_Pyro1.label: PU_EliminateSpecific_Caves_Pyro1
PU_EliminateSpecific_Caves_Pyro1.title: Ripe for Retribution
PU_EliminateSpecific_Caves_Pyro1.description:
Some interesting information just fell into my lap. Guess the notorious XenoThreat leader ~mission(TargetName) is holed up at ~mission(location|address) working on some big op for them. Perfect opportunity to kill the piece of shit once and for all.

Thing is, the Xenos have their eyes all over Headhunter operations at the moment. There’s no way we can mobilize and deploy a crew without ~mission(TargetName|Last) getting tipped off. So I’m offering you the chance to make Pyro a better place and earn some creds at the same time.

If interested, I suggest gearing up and finding some backup before heading out. You'll only get paid if you take out ~mission(TargetName|Last), but don’t hesitate to kill any other little XenoThugs that might be hiding there with ‘em.  

Stows out.

PU_EliminateSpecific_Outposts_Indy_Pyro_.label: PU_EliminateSpecific_Outposts_Indy_Pyro_XT
PU_EliminateSpecific_Outposts_Indy_Pyro_.title: Fight for a Free Pyro
PU_EliminateSpecific_Outposts_Indy_Pyro_.description:
XenoThreat’s efforts to keep outside influences from infecting this system is being tested by a group that dares to call itself Citizens for Prosperity. A prominent group member, ~mission(TargetName), has established operations at ~mission(Location|Address) and is already hard at work spreading their lies and propaganda to anyone that will listen. If we want Pyro to remain independent of UEE and alien influence, then something must be done about this now.  

That’s why XenoThreat is issuing a kill order for ~mission(TargetName|Last). And knowing how important they are to Citizens for Prosperity’s operations, I wouldn’t be surprised if you had to fight your way through a bunch of their most fanatical followers first before you even get a shot at them. But remember ~mission(TargetName|Last) is your target, and payment hinges solely on you making sure they’re eliminated. 

Comm. Spec. Engler

PU_EliminateSpecific_Outposts_Outlaw_Pyr.label: PU_EliminateSpecific_Outposts_Outlaw_Pyro_XT
PU_EliminateSpecific_Outposts_Outlaw_Pyr.title: Head Hunting
PU_EliminateSpecific_Outposts_Outlaw_Pyr.description:
The Headhunters have assembled a special strike team whose sole purpose is to attack, disrupt, and undermine our operations. As much as I’m loath to admit it, they’ve had a few small successes and are quickly becoming a concern. 

XenoThreat knows the best way to kill a snake is by cutting off its head, so we’re issuing a kill order for the strike team’s commander ~mission(TargetName), who according to our intelligence sources, has been hiding at ~mission(Location|Address) for a few days now. 

I’d expect strong resistance from the Headhunter forces there. From what we’ve heard, ~mission(TargetName|Last) got this command partially because of the fierce loyalty they inspire in others. Putting your own crew together to tackle this would be a solid operational strategy. 

Happy Head Hunting,

Comm. Spec. Engler

PU_Assassination_SyncedAssassination_Sta.label: PU_Assassination_SyncedAssassination_Stanton2_Ruto_Intro
PU_Assassination_SyncedAssassination_Sta.title: simultaneous release
PU_Assassination_SyncedAssassination_Sta.description:
Guess what ~mission(TargetName) and ~mission(TargetName2) have in common? 

You're gonna kill 'em both!

Difficult part is that I need you to kill them at the same time so that one doesn't have a chance to escape, or worse, kill the person trying to kill them. 

So put together a team to track one target while you handle the other. Divide and conquer!

And despite the fact they made a mess big enough to get themselves killed, my understanding is that they are relative lightweights. Don't expect you to meet too much resistance.

PU_Assassination_SyncedAssassination_Sta.label: PU_Assassination_SyncedAssassination_Stanton2_Ruto_Super
PU_Assassination_SyncedAssassination_Sta.title: double trouble
PU_Assassination_SyncedAssassination_Sta.description:
If you had asked me, I would've said ~mission(TargetName) and ~mission(TargetName2) would have wound up eventually killing each other. But instead you're going to get the honor of killing them both at the same time.

You're going to have to work for it, though.

Each one is trouble. Serious records, highly trained, and too smart to fly without backup.

Gather the best crew you can on this one. You'll need it. And don't be stingy. You can't spend credits if you're dead.

PU_Assassination_SyncedAssassination_Sta.label: PU_Assassination_SyncedAssassination_Stanton2_Ruto_Medium
PU_Assassination_SyncedAssassination_Sta.title: friends to the end
PU_Assassination_SyncedAssassination_Sta.description:
I really hope that you're not buddies with ~mission(TargetName) or ~mission(TargetName2) because I need you to ghost the pair of them... at the same time...

Of course they wouldn't make this easy on us and travel in the same ship or something obvious like that. No. You're going to have to put together a crew so that you can down both targets simultaneously. 

As soon as one of them is dead, be ready to drop the other one too. Can't risk either of them getting away.

And I figure I should mention that not only are both pretty good pilots, but that they'll be traveling with backup too. Nothing you can't handle I'm sure.

PU_Assassination_SyncedAssassination_Sta.label: PU_Assassination_SyncedAssassination_Stanton2_Ruto_VEasy
PU_Assassination_SyncedAssassination_Sta.title: death do us part
PU_Assassination_SyncedAssassination_Sta.description:
It's pretty touching when you run across a pair that's willing to die for one another. Stupid but touching.

~mission(TargetName) and ~mission(TargetName2) chose to stand by each other and now its gone and got them dead.

Find a friend of your own and hunt each of these two down. Make sure you kill them at the same time. Call it poetic justice.

They should die pretty easy. Maybe they'll have a ship or two with them but I don't think it'll be anything to worry about.

PU_Assassination_SyncedAssassination_Sta.label: PU_Assassination_SyncedAssassination_Stanton2_Ruto_VHard
PU_Assassination_SyncedAssassination_Sta.title: two for the price of two
PU_Assassination_SyncedAssassination_Sta.description:
~mission(TargetName) and ~mission(TargetName2). I think they may be related? Or dating? Doesn't really matter, someone wants them killed. 

I've arranged it so that you can hit them when they're not flying together. Safer for you this way. They are both serious business and fly with equally serious backup.

Make sure you and your crew time your attacks. I don't want one of them left alive or it's going to be a real headache.

PU_Assassination_SyncedAssassination_Sta.label: PU_Assassination_SyncedAssassination_Stanton2_Ruto_Hard
PU_Assassination_SyncedAssassination_Sta.title: twice the headache
PU_Assassination_SyncedAssassination_Sta.description:
Have another pair that needs simultaneous deathing. Seems to be getting more and more popular as a murder option. 

This time it's ~mission(TargetName) and ~mission(TargetName2). Both are supposed to be pretty skilled operators and they won't be flying alone. 

I'd make sure whoever you get to help you on this one can handle a fight.

PU_Assassination_SyncedAssassination_Sta.label: PU_Assassination_SyncedAssassination_Stanton2_Ruto_Easy
PU_Assassination_SyncedAssassination_Sta.title: together forever
PU_Assassination_SyncedAssassination_Sta.description:
Here's the deal. ~mission(TargetName) and ~mission(TargetName2) need to die at the same time. Unfortunately, they aren't gonna be in the same place.

A double hit can sound complicated, but if you hire some additional guns it shouldn't be all that hard to do two hits simultaneously.

Make sure you find folks who have skills as I have it on good authority that each'll be flying with some escorts for "protection."

PU_Assassination_SyncedAssassination_Sta.label: PU_Assassination_SyncedAssassination_Stanton1_Eckhart_Super
PU_Assassination_SyncedAssassination_Sta.title: Divide and Conquer
PU_Assassination_SyncedAssassination_Sta.description:
Normally, the pair of ~mission(TargetName) and ~mission(TargetName2) would be too much to take on together. They both are about as good as it gets when it comes to dogfighting and the crew they fly with are almost as good.

But recently they split - not sure why - and are flying separate for the moment.  Someone thinks this may be the best chance to take them out. 

Gather some personnel you can trust and plan a simultaneous raid against both targets. It's too dangerous to risk one of them living after such a direct move against them.

PU_Assassination_SyncedAssassination_Sta.label: PU_Assassination_SyncedAssassination_Stanton1_Eckhart_Medium
PU_Assassination_SyncedAssassination_Sta.title: Double Elimination
PU_Assassination_SyncedAssassination_Sta.description: Got a contract to take out two up and comers who've been stirring up trouble. It has to be clean, both done at the same time, or else they might cause even more trouble.  Long story short, you'll need some help on this one.\n\nBoth ~mission(TargetName) and ~mission(TargetName2) know how to handle themselves, and the people they fly with aren't no joke either. You can expect each of them to be guarded by a few ships.

PU_Assassination_SyncedAssassination_Sta.label: PU_Assassination_SyncedAssassination_Stanton1_Eckhart_Easy
PU_Assassination_SyncedAssassination_Sta.title: Double Tap
PU_Assassination_SyncedAssassination_Sta.description:
A price has been set on the heads of ~mission(TargetName) and ~mission(TargetName2). 

While having to hit two targets isn't that weird, the client wants to send a very specific message, so they need to targets hit at the exact same moment. The extra credits should make up for the hassle.

And unfortunately since the pair aren't traveling together, it goes without saying that to pull it off you're gonna need some help. Make sure you bring people you trust can handle more than one ships since the targets are known to travel with backup.

PU_Assassination_SyncedAssassination_Sta.label: PU_Assassination_SyncedAssassination_Stanton1_Eckhart_Hard
PU_Assassination_SyncedAssassination_Sta.title: Two In The Head
PU_Assassination_SyncedAssassination_Sta.description:
Contract's for two targets that need to be taken out at the same time. 

Guess the client is worried that if they aren't eliminated together, one of them will go dark and try to get some revenge.

They go by ~mission(TargetName) and ~mission(TargetName2).

Find yourself a team, divide and conquer.

And make sure whoever it is has got skills, because these two have a reputation for holding their own in a fight and they for sure won't be alone. Be ready for them to give you some trouble.

PU_Assassination_SyncedAssassination_Sta.label: PU_Assassination_SyncedAssassination_Stanton1_Eckhart_Intro
PU_Assassination_SyncedAssassination_Sta.title: Coordinated Takedown
PU_Assassination_SyncedAssassination_Sta.description:
Interesting assignment came my way. I need two separate targets taken out: ~mission(TargetName) and ~mission(TargetName2) 

Problem is, either one gets word about the other being hit, they’ll go to ground. Can’t risk losing either of them. 

It’ll take considerable coordination, but I want you to hit them both at the same exact time.  

And since you can’t be in two places at once, you’ll need to find someone you can trust to help on this.

Thankfully, my intel says that both the targets should be traveling alone. That should help make things a bit easier on you.

PU_Assassination_SyncedAssassination_Sta.label: PU_Assassination_SyncedAssassination_Stanton1_Eckhart_VEasy
PU_Assassination_SyncedAssassination_Sta.title: One-Two Combo
PU_Assassination_SyncedAssassination_Sta.description:
Have another pair that need to be eliminated:
~mission(TargetName) and ~mission(TargetName2)

They've been in the wind for a few days now, but just popped up. If we don't get them now, I'm not sure we will get another chance.  You need to enlist a partner to make sure both targets are hit at the same time.

As far as them putting up resistance, ~mission(TargetName) is known to bring along a friend to watch their back, and I suspect ~mission(TargetName2) will do likewise.

PU_Assassination_SyncedAssassination_Sta.label: PU_Assassination_SyncedAssassination_Stanton1_Eckhart_VHard
PU_Assassination_SyncedAssassination_Sta.title: Deadly Combination
PU_Assassination_SyncedAssassination_Sta.description:
~mission(TargetName) and ~mission(TargetName2).

Two serious operators who've recently decided to make a move against their boss. Each of the pair are traveling with a small, highly trained armada and cutting deep into territory that doesn't belong to them.

You, and whoever you recruit to help, are going to take them out and it has to be both at the same time so they can't regroup.

PU_Assassination_PVE_Vaughn_Rehiring.label: PU_Assassination_PVE_Vaughn_Rehiring
PU_Assassination_PVE_Vaughn_Rehiring.title: Another Chance to Impress
PU_Assassination_PVE_Vaughn_Rehiring.description:
It is not often in life that we get another chance to make a first impression, but I am going to provide to you with just that.

To say I was disappointed in how things last transpired on your last assassination attempt would be a severe understatement. However, here is your chance to prove yourself capable of more. 

Kill ~mission(TargetName) over at ~mission(Location|Address) and I will consider the slate wiped clean. 

Sincerely,
Vaughn

PU_Bounty_PVE_Pyro_CitizensForPyro.label: PU_Bounty_PVE_Pyro_CitizensForPyro
PU_Bounty_PVE_Pyro_CitizensForPyro.title: Eliminate XenoThreat Idris
PU_Bounty_PVE_Pyro_CitizensForPyro.description:
Hey, 

The rumors are true. XenoThreat has deployed an Idris to stalk and attack Citizens for Prosperity operations in a dramatic escalation of their hostility towards us. We just received word the ship, under the command of ~mission(TargetName), is advancing toward ~mission(location|address). We can’t get our own forces there fast enough to fight them, and are in desperate need of help. 

We’re looking to hire someone brave enough to take it to these bastards. It’s not enough to scare them away, we need to guarantee that it can’t come after us again. 

Not sure if you’ve faced down an Idris before, but it’s a tall task for someone to take on alone. I’d highly recommend recruiting others to the cause.   

Best,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

PU_Bounty_PVE_Family_01.label: PU_Bounty_PVE_Family_01
PU_Bounty_PVE_Family_01.title: Capture Arlington Gang Member Les Arlington
PU_Bounty_PVE_Family_01.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Group Warrant
CONTRACTOR STATUS: Independent
Approval code: = ~mission(Contractor|ApprovalCode)

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

*********
__Background Information__
A group warrant has been issued for the notorious Arlington ship jacking gang after their recent brazen attempted theft of an Idris from a repair yard. While the heist was stopped, the members of the group have scattered to the black. Eckhart Security has been granted the bounty for the immediate capture of all high-level gang members: Maltrox Arlington, Kass Dent, Nicks Cantwell,  Sam ‘Weepy’ Arlington, Oslo Arlington, and Les Arlington.
*********

An anonymous comm has tipped us off that Les Arlington, child of gang leader Maltrox Arlington, had been spotted picking up a delivery at a Covalex transfer center. We will provide you with the coordinates of where we believe their current whereabouts are.

Les is an experienced pilot who has been flying for almost as long as they’ve been walking and usually serves as the gang’s get-away pilot. It may be worthwhile to bring extra support ships in order to cut off any attempts at escape.

You are authorized to use whatever force is necessary to neutralize the target. 

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

Kass is suspected of a long list of murders, with these two only being the most recent. We recommend only bringing highly skilled wingman to try and keep the casualty count at a minimum.  

You are authorized to use whatever force is necessary to neutralize the target.

PU_Bounty_PVE_Family_07.title: Idris Stolen By Arlington Gang
PU_Bounty_PVE_Family_07.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Group Warrant
CONTRACTOR STATUS: Independent
Approval code: = ~mission(Contractor|ApprovalCode)

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

It appears that second time's the charm for the Arlington gang. After one failed attempt, the recently escaped criminal family has managed to boost an Idris from a repair yard. Now we know what the mining laser and biometrics they stole were for. 

Since we had such success capturing them the first time, Eckhart Security has been granted the warrant for the gang’s arrest. This is going to take considerable firepower to bring down a capital ship of this ability.

You are authorized to use whatever force is necessary to track down the Idris and neutralize the gang.

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract and will be adjusted based on the final evaluation of you and your team's combat effectiveness rating. 

This contract is non-negotiable.

PU_EliminateAll_Lawful_Stanton1.title: Evict Illegal Occupants
PU_EliminateAll_Lawful_Stanton1.description:
HURSTON DYNAMICS
OUTSOURCING DEPARTMENT

CONTRACT: Facility Sweep
CONTRACTOR AFFILIATION: Independent
OUTSOURCE MANAGER: G. Livingston
RISK ASSESSMENT: High
RUSH CONTRACT: No

Hurston is seeking a contractor willing to clear out the criminal occupants from ~mission(Location|Address).

The site has been used to host numerous illegal activities, so it is imperative that it is secured. 

You are authorized to take any actions necessary. Payment will be sent once the facility is confirmed to be clear. 



** The information transmitted may contain confidential and/or privileged material. Any review, retransmission, dissemination, or other use of or taking action in reliance upon this information by persons or entities other than the intended recipient is prohibited. **

PU_EliminateAll_Lawful_Stanton3.label: PU_EliminateAll_Lawful_Stanton3
PU_EliminateAll_Lawful_Stanton3.title: Clear Out Site
PU_EliminateAll_Lawful_Stanton3.description:
ATTN: Verified Mercenary Operators

We’ve gotten word that ~mission(Location|Address) is being used by some local criminals as a base of operations. BlacJac needs the site swept and any inhabitants cleared out of there. 

You are authorized to use lethal force if necessary.

Thanks,
Gloria Mesa

Private Contract Supervisor
BlacJac Security, "Protection Provided"

PU_EliminateAll_Lawful_Stanton4.label: PU_EliminateAll_Lawful_Stanton4
PU_EliminateAll_Lawful_Stanton4.title: Remove Illegal Occupants
PU_EliminateAll_Lawful_Stanton4.description:
ABOUT THE JOB
microTech Protection Services is looking for a detail-oriented security professional who can quickly and safely assist us in the complete removal of illegal occupants who have temporarily gained control of ~mission(Location|Address).

RESPONSIBILITIES
• Provide own transportation to ~mission(Location|Address).
• Remove all illegal occupants found within the site; using force as necessary.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
• 2 years of combined mercenary and/or security experience.
• Access to combat equipment and mode of transport.
• Available for immediate deployment.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
• Experience with rapid hostility de-escalation techniques.

PU_EliminateAll_Lawful_Stanton2.label: PU_EliminateAll_Lawful_Stanton2
PU_EliminateAll_Lawful_Stanton2.title: Clear Criminal Nest
PU_EliminateAll_Lawful_Stanton2.description:
Crusader Security has learned that ~mission(Location|Address) is currently being used as a base of operations for numerous illegal activities.

In order to put a stop to this "nest of criminals," we are seeking a contractor to go to the site and clear all the occupants. By force if necessary.

CONTRACT AUTHORIZED BY:
Liaison Officer Bautista
ID# 948J030K

PU_EliminateAll_Lawful_WithHelp_Stanton4.label: PU_EliminateAll_Lawful_WithHelp_Stanton4
PU_EliminateAll_Lawful_WithHelp_Stanton4.title: Defend Occupants
PU_EliminateAll_Lawful_WithHelp_Stanton4.description:
ABOUT THE JOB
microTech Protection Services is looking for a detail-oriented mercenary professional who can quickly and safely assist the security team stationed at ~mission(Location|Address) in protecting the site against hostile threats. 

Be aware that any friendly fire, accidental or otherwise, will not be tolerated. 

RESPONSIBILITIES
• Provide own transportation to ~mission(Location|Address).
• Help the local security team protect the site; using force as necessary.
• Avoid any friendly fire incidents.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
• 2 years of combined mercenary and/or security experience.
• Access to combat equipment and mode of transport.
• Available for immediate deployment.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
• Experience with rapid hostility de-escalation techniques.

PU_EliminateAll_Lawful_WithHelp_Stanton1.label: PU_EliminateAll_Lawful_WithHelp_Stanton1
PU_EliminateAll_Lawful_WithHelp_Stanton1.title: Assist in Defending Site
PU_EliminateAll_Lawful_WithHelp_Stanton1.description:
HURSTON DYNAMICS
OUTSOURCING DEPARTMENT

CONTRACT: Facility Protection
CONTRACTOR AFFILIATION: Independent
OUTSOURCE MANAGER: T. Spooner
RISK ASSESSMENT: High
RUSH CONTRACT: No

The security personnel at ~mission(Location|Address) is being threatened by a local criminal element and Hurston Security is seeking contractors to bolster their defenses and eliminate any hostiles who attempt to breach the site.

Note that you are only cleared to engage with confirmed hostiles. Assaulting any security personnel at the site will result in a breach of contract.

Payment will be sent once the facility is confirmed to be safe. 



** The information transmitted may contain confidential and/or privileged material. Any review, retransmission, dissemination, or other use of or taking action in reliance upon this information by persons or entities other than the intended recipient is prohibited. **

PU_EliminateAll_Lawful_WithHelp_Stanton2.label: PU_EliminateAll_Lawful_WithHelp_Stanton2
PU_EliminateAll_Lawful_WithHelp_Stanton2.title: Provide Backup
PU_EliminateAll_Lawful_WithHelp_Stanton2.description:
Crusader Security has learned that ~mission(Location|Address) is currently being threatened by a group of criminals.

While we have security personnel on site, we are looking to hire additional contractors to help them repel any attacks. 

Now, as a contractor, I’m not sure how used to working with a team you are, but I don’t want to hear anything about "friendly fire" or there’s going to be problems.

CONTRACT AUTHORIZED BY:
Liaison Officer Bautista
ID# 948J030K

PU_EliminateAll_Lawful_WithHelp_Stanton3.label: PU_EliminateAll_Lawful_WithHelp_Stanton3
PU_EliminateAll_Lawful_WithHelp_Stanton3.title: Protect Site
PU_EliminateAll_Lawful_WithHelp_Stanton3.description:
ATTN: Verified Mercenary Operators

We’ve gotten word from the security team at ~mission(Location|Address) that some of the local scum have been launching attacks. BlacJac is looking to have you go to the site and assist in protecting it from hostile threats.

Make sure you check your fire down there. I don't want to hear about any blue-on-blue incidents.

Thanks,
Gloria Mesa

Private Contract Supervisor
BlacJac Security, "Protection Provided"

PU_EliminateAll_Lawful_NoNonHostiles_Sta.label: PU_EliminateAll_Lawful_NoNonHostiles_Stanton4
PU_EliminateAll_Lawful_NoNonHostiles_Sta.title: Remove Illegal Occupants
PU_EliminateAll_Lawful_NoNonHostiles_Sta.description:
ABOUT THE JOB
microTech Protection Services is looking for a detail-oriented mercenary professional who can quickly and safely assist us in the complete removal of illegal occupants who have temporarily gained control of ~mission(Location|Address).

Be aware that our intel shows there are civilian workers onsite. Since their connection with the gang is unclear, they should be considered non-combatants. Any hostile action towards them will not be tolerated. 

RESPONSIBILITIES
• Provide own transportation to ~mission(Location|Address).
• Remove all hostile occupants found within the site; using force if necessary.
• Ensure the safety of any civilians who may be onsite. 

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
• 2 years of combined mercenary and/or security experience.
• Access to combat equipment and mode of transport.
• Available for immediate deployment.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
• Experience with rapid hostility de-escalation techniques.

PU_EliminateAll_Lawful_NoNonHostiles_Sta.label: PU_EliminateAll_Lawful_NoNonHostiles_Stanton3
PU_EliminateAll_Lawful_NoNonHostiles_Sta.title: Clear Out Site
PU_EliminateAll_Lawful_NoNonHostiles_Sta.description:
ATTN: Verified Mercenary Operators

We’ve gotten word that ~mission(Location|Address) is being used by some local criminals as base of operations. BlacJac is looking to have you sweep the site and clear out any hostiles. 

Our early reports show that there’s a good chance that the gang will have some civilians working for them on-site. We're not looking to be making headlines here, so try to remember that you are only cleared to engage with confirmed hostiles. 

Thanks,
Gloria Mesa

Private Contract Supervisor
BlacJac Security, "Protection Provided"

PU_EliminateAll_Lawful_NoNonHostiles_Sta.description:
HURSTON DYNAMICS
OUTSOURCING DEPARTMENT

CONTRACT: Facility Sweep
CONTRACTOR AFFILIATION: Independent
OUTSOURCE MANAGER: K. Restle
RISK ASSESSMENT: High
RUSH CONTRACT: No

Hurston is seeking a contractor willing to clear out criminal occupants from ~mission(Location|Address).

The site has been used to host numerous illegal activities, so it is imperative that it is secured. 

Note that you are only cleared to engage with confirmed hostiles. Assaulting any civilians at the site will be considered a violation of your contract.

Gloria Mesa

BlacJac Security, "Protection Provided"

Gloria Mesa

PU_EliminateAll_DC_Stanton_Stor_HDPC-Far.description:
HURSTON DYNAMICS OUTSOURCING
CONTRACT: Neutralize Hostile Force
OUTSOURCE MANAGER: T. Dalik
RISK ASSESSMENT: High

Our security forces have been notified of an ongoing outlaw incursion at ~mission(Location|Address), and we are in need of an independent operator capable of clearing out the hostile actors. 

According to onsite personnel, the outlaws are currently holed up near the ~mission(Location). Approach with caution and be prepared to use lethal force if the outlaws resist being removed.

Payment will only be authorized once the location has been effectively cleared.

PU_EliminateAll_DC_Stanton_Rfn_microTech.title: Remove Hostile Force
PU_EliminateAll_DC_Stanton_Rfn_microTech.description:
ABOUT THE JOB
microTech Protection Services is looking for a detail-oriented mercenary professional who can quickly and safely assist us in the complete removal of the outlaw group who have temporarily gained control of the ~mission(Location) at ~mission(Location|Address).

RESPONSIBILITIES
• Provide own transportation to ~mission(Location|Address).
• Remove all members of the hostile outlaw force; using force as necessary. 

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
• 2 years of combined mercenary and security experience.
• Access to combat equipment and mode of transport.
• Available for immediate deployment.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
• Experience with rapid hostility de-escalation techniques.

PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_RoughAndReady.label: PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_RoughAndReady_Random
PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_RoughAndReady.title: Suppress Spying Op
PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_RoughAndReady.missionGiver:
Interested in getting your hands dirty? Turns out someone set up a little operation at ~mission(location|address) to spy on Rough & Ready’s business dealings. They’ve got several orbital sentries and guard ships posted there. We don’t know who’s behind it, what kind of reinforcements they have waiting, or why they’re targeting us, but it’s definitely not for something good.  

Now, we could take care of it ourselves but have business interests to consider. Sometimes the best way to protect those interests is to hire mercs to do our dirty work. If you’re interested in making good creds and gaining a little good will with the R&R, now’s your chance. Interested? 

- Smokey

PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_RoughAndReady.label: PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_RoughAndReady_Intro
PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_RoughAndReady.title: Stop Spying Op
PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_RoughAndReady.description:
My associates and I have found ourselves in a little predicament and could use some help. There’s an orbital sentry at ~mission(location|address) that’s spying on us. We don’t know who put it there, but it sure as hell can’t stay. 

Thing is we’re business minded folks first and foremost and worry that if we blow it up ourselves it’ll start shit. That’s why it’s better if someone like you does it. Should be a quick and easy gig for someone interested in earning some creds.   

- Smokey

PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_HeadHunters_I.label: PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_HeadHunters_Intro
PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_HeadHunters_I.title: Erase Eavesdropper
PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_HeadHunters_I.description: Got a minor annoyance the Headhunters need dealt with. There's an orbital sentry at ~mission(location|address) that some pesky little troublemaker set up to spy on our ops. Want to make some easy creds and go blow it up for us?\n\nStows out.

PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_HeadHunters_R.label: PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_HeadHunters_Random
PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_HeadHunters_R.title: Execute Eavesdroppers
PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_HeadHunters_R.description:
Headhunters recently discovered some orbital sentries focused on our operations and we don’t like it one bit. I’m looking to pay someone to go to ~mission(location|address) and make it abundantly clear they should stay the hell out of our business. Doubt they’ll be receptive to a discussion about it, so I’d be prepared to evict them with extreme force. 

Based on our scans, this won’t be a walk in the park. Wouldn’t be a bad idea to come prepared with plenty of ammo. Payment will be sent promptly once the job is done. 

Stows out.

PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_XenoThreat_Ra.label: PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_XenoThreat_Random
PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_XenoThreat_Ra.title: Eliminate Sentries
PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_XenoThreat_Ra.description:
It appears the UEE are stepping up their efforts to stop our movement. One of our pilots discovered a few orbital sentries and ships at ~mission(location|address). We believe they’re part of a UEE espionage campaign targeting XenoThreat and it's vital that it be stopped before they gather anything that could harm our ongoing efforts.

We’re looking for a skilled merc willing to eliminate this threat and stop this invasion of privacy before it spreads even further. Who knows how much bigger this operation will get if it’s not taken off-line immediately? Payment will make it worth your while and be sent promptly once everything is blown to bits. 

See it done, and help be a part of the right side of history.

Comm. Spec. Engler

PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_XenoThreat_In.label: PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_XenoThreat_Intro
PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_XenoThreat_In.title: Surveillance Termination
PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_XenoThreat_In.description:
It seems our struggle to free Humanity has got the government lapdogs back on Earth feeling nervous. Recent scans discovered an orbital sentry at ~mission(location|address) that we believe is part of an UEE espionage campaign. Good credits says they’re handing the data direct to the slinks themselves. 

Only one sentry has been detected so far, but who knows how big the operation will grow if it’s not taken off-line. Shouldn’t be too much trouble for a skilled merc. If that sounds like you, payment will be sent promptly once the sentry is destroyed. Plus, XenoThreat will remember that you’re someone willing to fight for what’s right.

Comm. Spec. Engler

PU_Delivery_Local_DrugProduction_Stanton.label: PU_Delivery_Local_DrugProduction_Stanton4_Klim_LowReliability
PU_Delivery_Local_DrugProduction_Stanton.title: A Batch from Scratch
PU_Delivery_Local_DrugProduction_Stanton.description:
Normally, I like to cook everything from scratch myself. Pride in product and all. But every once in a while, whether it's too much demand or too much heat or whatever, I need to rely on other labs for an order. 

My hands are tied up here though, so I could use someone to help oversee the whole production line for me. Couldn't think of anyone better and more available than you.

~mission(Itinerary)

Just don't get distracted in the middle and wander off. It happens more often than you'd think. Manage to finish the full list, and I'll see to it you get nice cut of the profits.

-Wallace

PU_EliminateAll_Outposts_Derelict_Pyro_H.label: PU_EliminateAll_Outposts_Derelict_Pyro_HH
PU_EliminateAll_Outposts_Derelict_Pyro_H.title: Reputation Management
PU_EliminateAll_Outposts_Derelict_Pyro_H.description:
Some assholes are refusing to pay us what we’re owed. Problem is, these idiots are bragging about it. Had they kept it quiet, we could’ve taken care of this more surgically, but now we need to send a message.

The fools are operating from ~mission(Location|Address). We need them all gone. Make it as loud as you can. We’ll send your payment once everyone’s taken care of.

- Stows out.

PU_EliminateAll_Outposts_Derelict_Pyro_X.label: PU_EliminateAll_Outposts_Derelict_Pyro_XT
PU_EliminateAll_Outposts_Derelict_Pyro_X.title: Kill Order: "Citizens" at ~mission(location)
PU_EliminateAll_Outposts_Derelict_Pyro_X.description:
The group of instigators that calls itself “Citizens for Prosperity” can no longer be allowed to continue spreading their lies and propaganda without repercussion.

As a sharp reminder of who really controls Pyro we have issued a kill order to eradicate all “Citizen” presence at ~mission(location|address). Resistance is likely, but we expect you to handle it with little difficulty. Do as directed and you’ll be paid well for your work.

Comm. Spec. Engler

PU_MissingPerson_Pyro_RR_Pyro2.label: PU_MissingPerson_Pyro_RR_Pyro2
PU_MissingPerson_Pyro_RR_Pyro2.title: ~mission(TargetName) Vanished
PU_MissingPerson_Pyro_RR_Pyro2.description:
I’ve got people left and right askin’ me if I know what happened to ~mission(TargetName). Now personally, I’d be more than happy to see ‘em gone for good, but for whatever reason they got friends in high places demanding answers.

I can’t spare any of my people to go on a wild goose chase, so I'm looking for the perfect candidate to go over to ~mission(Location|Address) and find out what happened to ~mission(TargetName|Last). You’ll get paid if you find where they are.

10 credits says they got way too high and passed out in a dark corner somewhere.

-Smokey

PU_MissingPerson_Stations_Pyro_CFP_Pyro1.title: Missing: ~mission(TargetName)
PU_MissingPerson_Stations_Pyro_CFP_Pyro1.description:
Two locals we work with were out salvaging at ~mission(Location|Address) when they had some issues with faulty equipment. One managed to escape, but their partner, ~mission(TargetName) was unfortunately left behind.

With the state they were last reported to be in, I’m guessing they didn’t make it, but I’d like to know for sure. If you’re willing, I could use your help in finding their remains.

If you can track them down, I’ll see that you’re properly compensated for the effort.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

PU_EliminateBoss_Lawful_NoNonHostiles_St.title: Bounty Assignment: ~mission(TargetName) (HRT)
PU_EliminateBoss_Lawful_NoNonHostiles_St.description:
Hey, 

Got a contract for you that requires a bit more tactics than usual. A high-level criminal by the name ~mission(TargetName) is hiding with a large contingent of outlaws at ~mission(Location|Address). 

Our intel suggests that ~mission(TargetName|Last)’s forces most likely will act as defensive line in order to protect their boss. My best guess is that you will have to deal with them before you gain access to ~mission(TargetName|Last).

That said, I don’t want you shooting indiscriminately. Sometimes these outlaws keep civilians around and they should be treated like non-combatants.

Best of luck,

Braden Corchado
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group

PU_EliminateBoss_DC_Stanton_Stor_Greycat.title: Apprehend Bounty: ~mission(TargetName) (HRT)
PU_EliminateBoss_DC_Stanton_Stor_Greycat.description:
ABOUT THE JOB
microTech Protection Services is looking for a qualified bounty hunter to apprehend ~mission(TargetName) who has so far been able to evade capture. They are coordinating an active raid at ~mission(Location|Address), and we believe that they may finally be lured out of hiding if their forces there attacking the ~mission(Location) are faced with strong enough resistance. 

RESPONSIBILITIES
• Provide own transportation to ~mission(Location|Address).
• Neutralize ~mission(TargetName)’s criminal associates near the ~mission(Location) to draw the target into the open.
• Neutralize ~mission(TargetName); using force if necessary.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
• Access to combat equipment and mode of transport.
• Available for immediate deployment.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
• Ability to handle high pressure situations.

PU_EliminateBoss_DC_Stanton_Rfn_HDPC-Far.label: PU_EliminateBoss_DC_Stanton_Rfn_HDPC-Farnesway
PU_EliminateBoss_DC_Stanton_Rfn_HDPC-Far.title: Elusive Bounty: ~mission(TargetName) (HRT)
PU_EliminateBoss_DC_Stanton_Rfn_HDPC-Far.description:
HURSTON DYNAMICS OUTSOURCING
CONTRACT: Bounty Collection
OUTSOURCE MANAGER: I. Takao
RISK ASSESSMENT: High Risk Target (Armed Support)

Hurston Dynamics is seeking a contractor to complete a bounty for ~mission(TargetName). This bounty has proven extremely elusive so far, but intel reports have tracked the target and a cohort of their known associates to ~mission(Location|Address). 

However, there is a strong chance that ~mission(TargetName|Last) will not risk a confrontation unless absolutely forced to. It is our recommendation that you neutralize a significant portion of the criminal’s allies first in order to draw them out. The report indicates that a large party of these hostiles are currently near the ~mission(Location).

Payment will be released only after the bounty has been deemed complete.




** The information transmitted may contain confidential and/or privileged material. Any review, retransmission, dissemination or other use of or taking action in reliance upon this information by persons or entities other than the intended recipient is prohibited. **

PU_EliminateBoss_DC_Stanton_Lob_Abandone.label: PU_EliminateBoss_DC_Stanton_Lob_Abandoned-Dupree
PU_EliminateBoss_DC_Stanton_Lob_Abandone.title: ~mission(TargetName)’s Time Has Come
PU_EliminateBoss_DC_Stanton_Lob_Abandone.description:
We’ve had our sights set on taking out ~mission(TargetName) for a while now, but we’ve never been able to find the right moment. Enough waiting. You’re going to create the right moment for us.

Head to ~mission(Location|Address) and take out a bunch of lowlifes running around the ~mission(Location). Kill enough of those losers, and ~mission(TargetName|Last) will have no choice but to come face you themselves. That’s when you take ‘em out and earn yourself a nice fat payday.

PU_RetrieveConsignment_Stanton2_Illegal_.label: PU_RetrieveConsignment_Stanton2_Illegal_Medium
PU_RetrieveConsignment_Stanton2_Illegal_.title: get the goods
PU_RetrieveConsignment_Stanton2_Illegal_.description:
Oh hello, I recently overheard a little bit of intel that ~mission(location|address) received some confidential materials that are of great interest to an acquaintance of mine. So interesting that they’re willing to pay for someone to storm the facility, grab the goods, and deliver them to ~mission(DropOff1|address). Now I expect there to be plenty of security, who will most likely put up a fight, so I’d bring a gun or two. 

Word is the confidential materials were delivered in a consignment alongside other stuff and are now being stored in the facility’s automated vault. Senior security officers on-site carry datapads containing retrieval codes used to access the vault. You’ll have to get your hands on a datapad before using the package conveyor to retrieve the boxes. 

If you need a little sweetener, I’ve seen the manifest and can confirm that the other crates being stored at the facility are pretty choice. My client could care less about what happens to them, so they’re yours to do as you please. Run this right and those extra crates could be a nice bonus on top of the delivery fee for you.

PU_RetrieveConsignment_Stanton2_Legal_Ea.label: PU_RetrieveConsignment_Stanton2_Legal_Easy
PU_RetrieveConsignment_Stanton2_Legal_Ea.title: Support Security Forces and Secure Confidential Materials
PU_RetrieveConsignment_Stanton2_Legal_Ea.description:
Reports indicate that our security staff at ~mission(location|address) have been wiped out by a group of Nine Tails, who are attempting to steal confidential materials that were recently delivered to the facility. Crusader Security needs an experienced contractor to expel the hostiles and secure these boxes. 

Based on the initial reports, we strongly recommend that you come well-equipped and consider bringing back-up. For security purposes, the confidential materials were transported there as part of a consignment with other boxes and locked in an automated vault. The retrieval codes to access the confidential materials are stored on datapads held by high-ranking security staff, but we don’t know who has them now. Odds are that the Nine Tails will be looking for them too.  

When you have all the confidential materials, deliver them to ~mission(dropoff1|address) to receive payment. 

CONTRACT AUTHORIZED BY: 
Liaison Officer Bautista 
ID# 948J030K

PU_RetrieveConsignment_Stanton4_Legal_Ea.label: PU_RetrieveConsignment_Stanton4_Legal_Easy
PU_RetrieveConsignment_Stanton4_Legal_Ea.title: Defend Location and Deliver Confidential Materials
PU_RetrieveConsignment_Stanton4_Legal_Ea.description:
ABOUT THE JOB
microTech Protection Services need a security professional for a retrieval op at ~mission(Location). The location is currently under attack and security forces on-site are unresponsive and presumed dead. We believe confidential materials recently delivered to the facility for temporary holding were the target of the raid. Your main focus will be collecting those boxes and delivering them to a secure location.  

For security reasons, the confidential materials were delivered as part of a larger shipment and secured in the automated vault. The materials have unique retrieval codes that must be entered on the keypad at the package conveyor. Protocols require that only senior security officers can carry a datapad containing a code, but considering the volatile situation, we can't guarantee that the Nine Tails haven’t taken possession of them. Once secured, deliver all of the confidential materials to ~mission(dropoff1) for payment.

RESPONSIBILITIES
• Provide own transportation to ~mission(Location|address).
• Use force as necessary to collect the confidential materials.
• Deliver the confidential materials to ~mission(dropoff1|address).

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
• 2 years of combined mercenary and/or security experience.
• Access to combat equipment. 
• Access to a spaceship that can transport cargo.
• Available for immediate deployment.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
• Experience with rapid hostility de-escalation techniques.
• Experience hauling important cargo.
