PU_RetrieveConsignment_Stanton3_Legal_In.description:
ATTN: Mercenaries with Cargo Handling Experience

Nine Tails are currently assaulting one of our facilities at ~mission(Location|address). As they just received a delivery of confidential materials, we don’t believe this is a coincidence. BlacJac needs someone to hurry to the location and secure these important boxes before the Nine Tails do. You are authorized to use lethal force against any who attempt to stop you. 

As part of our standard security protocol, the confidential materials were integrated into another consignment and secured in the automated vault. You’ll need to find the relevant retrieval codes for the confidential materials and enter it at the package conveyor to retrieve the boxes. Retrieval codes are stored locally on datapads and only given to high-ranking staff. Hopefully they’re alive to help you, but considering the complete comms blackout, we fear that’s not the case. There's a chance Nine Tails have already gotten their hands on the datapads.  

Once you’ve gathered all the confidential materials, they will need to be delivered to ~mission(dropoff1|address). Payment is contingent upon their delivery.


Thanks,
Gloria Mesa

Private Contract Supervisor
BlacJac Security, "Protection Provided"

PU_RetrieveConsignment_Pyro_CFP_Pyro6.title: Confidential Material Stolen
PU_RetrieveConsignment_Pyro_CFP_Pyro6.description:
You available for a job? One of our secure locations got hit by outlaws and some highly confidential material was stolen. As you can imagine, Citizens for Prosperity is eager to recover them as soon as possible.

Thanks to a local contact, we were able to trace the outlaws back to ~mission(Location|Address) where they're storing the confidential materials inside a secure automated vault. To access it, you’ll need to first find the relevant retrieval code and enter it at the vault’s package conveyor. Our best guess is that one of outlaw leaders will be carrying the code on their person so there is a very strong chance you’ll have to engage with them directly to get it.
  
Once you’ve gotten possession of the confidential material, we want you to deliver it to ~mission(Dropoff1|Address).

You’ll be making a big difference to a lot of people if you manage to pull this off.

Thanks in advance,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

PU_RetrieveConsignment_Stanton1_Legal_Me.label: PU_RetrieveConsignment_Stanton1_Legal_Medium
PU_RetrieveConsignment_Stanton1_Legal_Me.title: Defend Site and Retrieve Confidential Materials
PU_RetrieveConsignment_Stanton1_Legal_Me.description:
HURSTON DYNAMICS
OUTSOURCING DEPARTMENT

CONTRACT: Facility Sweep & Package Retrieval
CONTRACTOR AFFILIATION: Independent
OUTSOURCE MANAGER: G. Livingston
RISK ASSESSMENT: High
RUSH CONTRACT: Yes

Hurston has learned that the Nine Tails are attacking ~mission(Location|address). Our on-site forces have suffered heavy casualties and stopped responding to comms. Initial reports indicated that the gang was attempting to obtain confidential material recently delivered to the facility. Thankfully, we have security measures in place that should give us time to respond. We need an operative to head to the facility immediately, retrieve those boxes, and deliver them to a secure location.

You and whatever backup you choose to bring are authorized to take any actions necessary when confronting the trespassers. Suspects are considered armed and dangerous. Hurston will not provide material support and/or updates regarding the status of the facility's security forces. 

The confidential materials were discreetly delivered alongside other boxes in a consignment and locked in our automated vault with access codes kept on datapads held by senior security staff. However, there’s a strong chance Nine Tails may already have gotten their hands on them. You’ll need to find those datapads and then enter the codes at the package conveyor to retrieve the confidential materials. Payment will be sent once they have been delivered to ~mission(dropoff1|address). 


** The information transmitted may contain confidential and/or privileged material. Any review, retransmission, dissemination, or other use of or taking action in reliance upon this information by persons or entities other than the intended recipient is prohibited. **

Oh hello, I recently overheard a little bit of intel that ~mission(location|address) received some confidential materials that are of great interest to an acquaintance of mine. So interesting that they’re willing to pay for someone to storm the facility, grab the goods, and deliver them to ~mission(DropOff1|address). Now I expect there to be plenty of security, who will most likely put up a fight, so I’d bring a gun or two. 

Word is the confidential materials were delivered in a consignment alongside other stuff and are now being stored in the facility’s automated vault. Senior security officers on-site carry datapads containing retrieval codes used to access the vault. You’ll have to get your hands on a datapad before using the package conveyor to retrieve the boxes. 

If you need a little sweetener, I’ve seen the manifest and can confirm that the other crates being stored at the facility are pretty choice. My client could care less about what happens to them, so they’re yours to do as you please. Run this right and those extra crates could be a nice bonus on top of the delivery fee for you.

HURSTON DYNAMICS
OUTSOURCING DEPARTMENT

CONTRACT: Bounty Collection
CONTRACTOR AFFILIATION: Independent
OUTSOURCE MANAGER: I. Takao
RISK ASSESSMENT: Moderate Risk Target (Likely Armed Support)
RUSH CONTRACT: No

Hurston Dynamics is seeking a contractor to complete a bounty for ~mission(TargetName).

PU_Inhabited_Derelict_Settlements_Recove.label: PU_Inhabited_Derelict_Settlements_Recover_Stash_Lawful_Stanton1
PU_Inhabited_Derelict_Settlements_Recove.title: Retrieval Op
PU_Inhabited_Derelict_Settlements_Recove.description:
Here's the deal – a client of ours (who should have spent the extra credits for a Northrock escort) had one of their ships attacked and now they need us to run point on a retrieval op for an important package that was stolen.

Thankfully, we caught a break and were able to track down the people responsible to <EM4>~mission(Pickup1|Address)</EM4>. We need you to head there and recover the package. You'll be able to ID it by its serial number: <EM4>#~mission(Item1|SerialNumber)</EM4>.

I expect that the outlaws are going to put up a fight, but just remember that they aren't the priority.

Once you got the package, fly it back to the client at <EM4>~mission(Dropoff1|Address)</EM4>. 

One last thing, make sure you bring a ship that has enough room for some cargo. Don't want you getting all the way there in your Gladius or whatever only to have to turn back.

Do us proud,

Braden Corchado
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group

*RETRIEVAL OPERATION SUMMARY*
* Recover Package <EM4>#~mission(Item1|SerialNumber)</EM4> from <EM4>~mission(Pickup1|Address)</EM4>
* Deliver to <EM4>~mission(Dropoff1|Address)</EM4>

PU_DestroyNarcotics_Illegal_Stanton1_E.label: PU_DestroyNarcotics_Illegal_Stanton1_E
PU_DestroyNarcotics_Illegal_Stanton1_E.title: limited supply
PU_DestroyNarcotics_Illegal_Stanton1_E.description:
Seems there’s a new upstart in the sector who hasn’t been paying the right dues to the right people. To teach them a little lesson, my client wants you to go down to ~mission(Location|Address) and destroy all the drugs on site.

The low-level lugs they got on site will probably make a stink about it and try to stop you. Handle them however you want but getting rid of the product is the most important thing.

PU_DestroyNarcotics_Illegal_Stanton1_M.label: PU_DestroyNarcotics_Illegal_Stanton1_M
PU_DestroyNarcotics_Illegal_Stanton1_M.title: out of stock
PU_DestroyNarcotics_Illegal_Stanton1_M.description:
One of my clients has been unhappy to learn that someone's been muscling in on their territory. Now rather than going down the more traditional route of killing some people and starting a whole thing, they’ve opted to send a different kind of message instead.

You’re gonna go down to ~mission(Location|Address) and destroy all the drugs on site. 

Of course, if someone does wanna pick a fight with you, feel free to defend yourself, but getting rid of the product is the most important thing.

PU_DestroyNarcotics_Illegal_Stanton1_H.label: PU_DestroyNarcotics_Illegal_Stanton1_H
PU_DestroyNarcotics_Illegal_Stanton1_H.title: inventory clear out
PU_DestroyNarcotics_Illegal_Stanton1_H.description:
A client of mine‘s trying to negotiate a deal, but isn’t having much luck. The other party feels like they got all the leverage because they’re sitting comfortably on a pile of inventory. To help move the negotiations along, I’m gonna need you to head down to ~mission(Location|Address) and destroy all the drugs on site. 

Now, I should probably tell you that the site’s being protected by some very serious people, so getting to the stash is going to be a bit tricky, but I trust you’ll find a way.

PU_Destroy_BombingRun_DC_Stanton_CryAstr.title: Up in Smoke
PU_Destroy_BombingRun_DC_Stanton_CryAstr.description:
We’ve been trying to access some sensitive data over at ~mission(Location|Address) but there seems to only be one backdoor we can use. The issue is we need someone onsite to trigger it. And I really do mean trigger it.

If you can head over there and destroy part of their infrastructure, the emergency back up systems will kick online and we should be able to access everything we want. 

Wish I could see the surprise look on the faces of the lowlifes running the place when it happens.

-Bit Zeros

PU_DestroyNarcotics_legal_Stanton2_H.title: Destroy Deadly Contraband
PU_DestroyNarcotics_legal_Stanton2_H.description:
A fledgling syndicate have set up shop over at ~mission(Location|Address) and have been trying their hand at cracking into the drug market. Unfortunately, their product has been linked to several deaths in and around Crusader. With how potent this stuff is, it’s posing a serious threat to the public. 

Crusader is working to take down the whole operation, but as long as their product is circulating, the bodies are starting to pile up. 

We want you to go the site and destroy the stash they have there before they get a chance to sell it. However, you should expect their stash to be extremely well guarded.

CONTRACT AUTHORIZED BY:
Liaison Officer Bautista
ID# 948J030K

PU_DestroyNarcotics_legal_Stanton2_M.label: PU_DestroyNarcotics_legal_Stanton2_M
PU_DestroyNarcotics_legal_Stanton2_M.title: Destroy Toxic Narcotics
PU_DestroyNarcotics_legal_Stanton2_M.description:
We’ve been investigating a recent bout of OD’s and they all seem to have originated with a bad batch of drugs made over at ~mission(Location|Address). 

I’m working with other contractors to ferret out those responsible, but people are dying as long is the product is still out there. 

I want you to go the site and destroy the stash they have there. Should buy us some time before we shut them down for good.

They will have guards protecting their supply, so be prepared to engage with hostiles.

CONTRACT AUTHORIZED BY:
Liaison Officer Bautista
ID# 948J030K

PU_DestroyNarcotics_legal_Stanton2_E.label: PU_DestroyNarcotics_legal_Stanton2_E
PU_DestroyNarcotics_legal_Stanton2_E.title: Destroy Illegal Drugs
PU_DestroyNarcotics_legal_Stanton2_E.description:
We’ve discovered that a group is trying to start up their own drug business over at ~mission(Location|Address). While they seem to be your average low-level thugs, the product they’re producing is toxic and responsible for the deaths of multiple civilians, so we can’t afford to allow any more to be sold.

We’re are working on a larger operation that will shut them down for good, but in the meanwhile we need to stop the flow of their drugs. That’s why Crusader wants you to go the site and destroy the stash they have there.

They will undoubtedly have guards protecting the stash, but I don’t expect them to be too much of a threat.

CONTRACT AUTHORIZED BY:
Liaison Officer Bautista
ID# 948J030K

PU_DestroyNarcotics_legal_Stanton3_H.title: Destroy Dangerous Drugs
PU_DestroyNarcotics_legal_Stanton3_H.description:
ATTN: Verified Mercenary Operators

Some enterprising chemists have cooked up a new product that is twice as potent and twice as deadly as the normal stuff. We were able to trace some samples back to the source over at ~mission(Location|Address). 

BlacJac wants you to head down ASAP to destroy the entire batch before it can hurt any more of the population. We can worry about making arrests later.

From everything we know about this crew, you should expect to meet heavy resistance while attempting to clear out the stash.


Thanks,
Gloria Mesa

Private Contract Supervisor
BlacJac Security, "Protection Provided"

PU_DestroyNarcotics_legal_Stanton3_E.label: PU_DestroyNarcotics_legal_Stanton3_E
PU_DestroyNarcotics_legal_Stanton3_E.title: Wipe Out Drug Stash
PU_DestroyNarcotics_legal_Stanton3_E.description:
ATTN: Verified Mercenary Operators

It seems there’s a new operator trying their hand at manufacturing drugs over at ~mission(Location|Address), but the product they’re putting out is extremely toxic. 

We’re sorting through how to handle the arrests, but the important thing is to prevent any more of their supply getting distributed. I need you to get down there and destroy the drugs they’re storing on site.

There's a good chance the facility isn't abandoned, so you might run into these thugs when you head down there, so be ready for a fight. But if their gun skills are anything like their chemistry, it probably won’t be much of one. 

Thanks,
Gloria Mesa

Private Contract Supervisor
BlacJac Security, "Protection Provided"

PU_DestroyNarcotics_legal_Stanton3_M.label: PU_DestroyNarcotics_legal_Stanton3_M
PU_DestroyNarcotics_legal_Stanton3_M.title: Clear Out Drugs
PU_DestroyNarcotics_legal_Stanton3_M.description:
ATTN: Verified Mercenary Operators

We got word that a syndicate spiked a rival’s drug package and its causing chaos on the streets. Forensics have identified the source, a production facility over at ~mission(Location|Address). Word is the drug manufacturers don’t even know they have a poisoned crop on their hands.

We’re sorting through how to handle the arrests, but the important thing is to get this crap off the streets now. I need you to get down there and destroy the drugs they’re storing on site.

They won’t be happy about it, so you’ll probably have a fight on your hands, but the important thing is clearing out the product.

Thanks,
Gloria Mesa

Private Contract Supervisor
BlacJac Security, "Protection Provided"

PU_DestroyNarcotics_legal_Stanton4_H.label: PU_DestroyNarcotics_legal_Stanton4_H
PU_DestroyNarcotics_legal_Stanton4_H.title: Clear Site of Narcotics
PU_DestroyNarcotics_legal_Stanton4_H.description:
ABOUT THE JOB

PU_Destroy_Servers_KeypadLocked_DC_Stant.label: PU_Destroy_Servers_KeypadLocked_DC_Stanton_Lobby_CryAstro
PU_Destroy_Servers_KeypadLocked_DC_Stant.title: Server Not Found
PU_Destroy_Servers_KeypadLocked_DC_Stant.description:
Hey,

Got a problem we could use your help on. One of our former new-recruits did a complete crap job on a hack and wound up leaving a digital footprint so messy that it might as well be a full confession. 

A remote deletion’s not going to be good enough so I want you to go to ~mission(Location|Address) and make sure their data servers are wiped from existence.

As if this wasn’t a big enough of a mess already, the access codes to the locked server room door are only stored physically on site. That means you’re going to have to liberate a datapad with the code on it first before you can even get close to them.

Don’t worry though. I’ll make sure the creds are worth all the hassle.  

- Bit Zeros

PU_Destroy_Generator_KeypadLocked_DC_Sta.label: PU_Destroy_Generator_KeypadLocked_DC_Stanton_Lobby_CryAstro
PU_Destroy_Generator_KeypadLocked_DC_Sta.title: Mandatory Black Out
PU_Destroy_Generator_KeypadLocked_DC_Sta.description:
I need your help on a job, but I can’t get too detailed about the specifics. If that doesn’t work for you, than don’t worry about it.

You’re going to head to ~mission(Location|Address) and blow up a power generator for us. Now, they keep the gen locked up, so you’ll have to hunt down the access codes first. Thankfully, they typically keep copies of the code on datapads. (Thinks it’ll keep ‘em safe from being hacked.)

You get that generator destroyed, and it’ll be your bank account blowin’ up next.

- Bit Zeros

PU_Destroy_BombingRun_Pyro_AttackHH.label: PU_Destroy_BombingRun_Pyro_AttackHH
PU_Destroy_BombingRun_Pyro_AttackHH.title: Fuel to the Fire
PU_Destroy_BombingRun_Pyro_AttackHH.description:
If you’re in the market for some easy credits, I’ve got an offer for you.

See, word on the vine is that ~mission(location|address) is operating as a fuel depot. They must not have gotten the memo that the fuel trade in Pyro belongs to Rough & Ready.

That’s why you’re going to make your way there and destroy their fuel reserves. They should be easy for you to spot. They’re the large yellow storage tanks dotted around the outpost. Watch out though, there are turret emplacements defending the area, so make sure you’re ready to dodge their shots or blow the guns sky high. 

I’ll leave it up to you how you handle the demo. Bombs would be my first choice, but I don’t care much as long as the gig gets done.

- Smokey

PU_EliminateAll_Stations_Hatch_Pyro_RR.label: PU_EliminateAll_Stations_Hatch_Pyro_RR
PU_EliminateAll_Stations_Hatch_Pyro_RR.title: Extermination Job
PU_EliminateAll_Stations_Hatch_Pyro_RR.description:
Rough & Ready has a rat problem. One of our crews tried to pull a little mutiny and now they’ve taken over ~mission(location|address).

Since I can’t be 100% sure they don’t have sympathizers onboard the station, I want you to handle putting down these traitors for me.

If you can clear out our little pest issue you’ll be paid handsomely. Just don’t leave a single one of them alive. Don’t want anyone else getting funny ideas.

- Smokey

PU_EliminateAll_Stations_Hangar_Pyro_RR.label: PU_EliminateAll_Stations_Hangar_Pyro_RR
PU_EliminateAll_Stations_Hangar_Pyro_RR.title: Unwanted Guests
PU_EliminateAll_Stations_Hangar_Pyro_RR.description:
We got some outlaws overstaying their welcome on one of our stations. They tried to pull a fast one on us but now they’re trapped in ~mission(location|address). We need you to clear ‘em out. 

Rough & Ready doesn’t want a single one of them left alive when you’re through. Don’t care how messy it gets as long as it gets done, got it?

- Smokey

HaulCargo_AToB_Stanton1_ReHire.label: HaulCargo_AToB_Stanton1_ReHire
HaulCargo_AToB_Stanton1_ReHire.title: Covalex Cargo Hauling Re-evaluation
HaulCargo_AToB_Stanton1_ReHire.description:
Hey,

Have a bit of good news for you. Covalex recently finished an evaluation of our contractor pool, and decided to reconsider your status as a cargo hauler. To requalify, all you need is to successfully complete the following delivery.

Pick up <EM4>~mission(Item)</EM4> from a freight elevator at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> and deliver it to a freight elevator at <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address)</EM4>. In order to complete this haul in a fast and efficient manner, you'll need a ship that can haul <EM4>~mission(MissionMaxSCUSize) cargo containers</EM4>.

Hopefully everything goes smoothly so we can welcome you back to the team.

By the way, we strongly encourage contractors to bring a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> along.   

Covalex Shipping  
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'







Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.

PU_Inhabited_Derelict_Settlements_Elimin.label: PU_Inhabited_Derelict_Settlements_EliminateSpecific_Lawful_Standard_Stanton1
PU_Inhabited_Derelict_Settlements_Elimin.title: Entrenched Bounty: ~mission(TargetName) (MRT)
PU_Inhabited_Derelict_Settlements_Elimin.description:
HURSTON DYNAMICS
OUTSOURCING DEPARTMENT

CONTRACT: Bounty Collection
CONTRACTOR AFFILIATION: Independent
OUTSOURCE MANAGER: ~mission(Contractor|Auth)
RISK ASSESSMENT: Moderate Risk Target (Possible Armed Support)
RUSH CONTRACT: ~mission(Contractor|BountyTimed)

Under the authority of Hurston Dynamics as granted by the UEE, a bounty has been issued for ~mission(TargetName) relating to crimes against the corporation. 

The subject is believed to be recently located at ~mission(Location|Address), potentially with several allies. Force may be required to gain access to the site and neutralize ~mission(TargetName|Last). ~mission(Location|CaveSize)

Payment will be released only after the bounty has been deemed complete.
 

** The information transmitted may contain confidential and/or privileged material. Any review, retransmission, dissemination or other use of or taking action in reliance upon this information by persons or entities other than the intended recipient is prohibited. **

PU_Theft_Outpost_Pyro_CFP_vs_GenericOutl.label: PU_Theft_Outpost_Pyro_CFP_vs_GenericOutlaw
PU_Theft_Outpost_Pyro_CFP_vs_GenericOutl.title: Stolen Supplies
PU_Theft_Outpost_Pyro_CFP_vs_GenericOutl.description:
Hey,

We could use your help.

A local we work with was completing a delivery for us, but unfortunately, she ran into some outlaws and had to surrender her ~mission(Item). Silver lining is the outlaws didn’t notice the trackers we placed in the cargo and now we know they’ve taken their haul to ~mission(Location|Address). 

We’d like you to recover the packages for us and finish delivering them to ~mission(Destination|Address). I don’t imagine the outlaws will give them up willingly, but I wouldn’t ask you to put yourself in harm’s way if these supplies weren’t of critical importance.

Also, to make your life easier, I'd suggest you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. 

So, what do you say?

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

PU_Assassination_PVE_Vaughn_Stanton1_Int.label: PU_Assassination_PVE_Vaughn_Stanton1_Intro
PU_Assassination_PVE_Vaughn_Stanton1_Int.title: A Chance to Impress
PU_Assassination_PVE_Vaughn_Stanton1_Int.description:
Firstly, allow me to introduce myself. To put it rather dramatically, I deal in lives. 

People hire me when some soul needs to be extinguished, and I in return employ the perfect person to serve as the extinguishant. This provides security to all parties involved as none know the identity of the other. An ideal situation as far as these things go.

I was recently made aware that you may possess skills that would make you of service to me and decided that it would be worthwhile to pursue the validity of this claim. 
 
If you have any interest in forging a working relationship, I will need a demonstration of said skills. 

Seek out and discreetly kill ~mission(TargetName) over at ~mission(Location|Address).

Do so successfully and you will be rewarded. Not only that, but you will have proven yourself worthy of further consideration.

Sincerely,
Vaughn

PU_PVP_Bounty_Stanton_NorthRock_PrisonEs.label: PU_PVP_Bounty_Stanton_NorthRock_PrisonEscapee
PU_PVP_Bounty_Stanton_NorthRock_PrisonEs.title: Escapee Bounty Assignment: ~mission(TargetName)
PU_PVP_Bounty_Stanton_NorthRock_PrisonEs.description:
Convicted criminal ~mission(TargetName) has escaped from a local rehab facility and Northrock's been contracted to return the inmate to custody. In my experience, escaped prisoners tend not to give up peacefully, so use any method you can to find and subdue the escapee. 

Might be worth staking out spots where they could attempt to hack their record clean. Wouldn't be the first time a prisoner has tried to wipe their sentence after escaping.

Good hunting,

Braden Corchado
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group

PU_Bounty_PVE_Group_NorthRock_ReHiring.label: PU_Bounty_PVE_Group_NorthRock_ReHiring
PU_Bounty_PVE_Group_NorthRock_ReHiring.title: Pro Tem Group Warrant (Reevaluation)
PU_Bounty_PVE_Group_NorthRock_ReHiring.description:
Hey,

I've been thinking over everything that went down and decided to speak to management. They've agreed to give you another chance but only if you successfully complete a contract for us.

We can look at reinstating your employment status if you can bring in this criminal trio:
~mission(Target1)
~mission(Target2)
~mission(Target3)

They evaded the last Associate who went after them, so you bringing them all in would definitely earn you some points.

Hopefully you've gotten your act together since your last job.

Braden Corchado
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group

PU_Bounty_PVE_Group_NorthRock_Intro.label: PU_Bounty_PVE_Group_NorthRock_Intro
PU_Bounty_PVE_Group_NorthRock_Intro.title: Pro Tem Group Warrant Contract
PU_Bounty_PVE_Group_NorthRock_Intro.description:
Hey,

Hope everything is going all right. I may have reached out already, but I wanted to be sure and introduce myself. I'm a logistics officer for Northrock Service Group, the leading independently-owned security firm operating in the Stanton system today, providing a variety of services to all major governmental bodies as well as various private concerns. The reason I am contacting you is because we believe someone with your skills could be a boon to our clients. 

Not only that, but I think we'd be good fit for you. Our contractors traditionally get a higher rate of pay than a lot of our competitors in system, and a lot of them tell me how they really enjoy being tasked with the challenging and interesting work we offer. 

Now, Northrock holds itself to such high-standards so before we can make anything official, you'll need to achieve approved contractor status by completing a pro tem contract. 

I was hoping you could capture several wanted members of an outlaw gang: ~mission(Target1), ~mission(Target2), and ~mission(Target3).

Get that done and we'll see about getting you more work.

Hope to hear from you soon, 

Braden Corchado
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group

PU_Bounty_PVE_Group_Stanton1_Eckhart.label: PU_Bounty_PVE_Group_Stanton1_Eckhart
PU_Bounty_PVE_Group_Stanton1_Eckhart.title: Group Warrant Issued
PU_Bounty_PVE_Group_Stanton1_Eckhart.description:
CONTRACT TYPE: Group Warrant
CONTRACTOR STATUS: Independent
Approval code: = ~mission(Contractor|ApprovalCode)

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

In relation to a jointly committed crime, a group warrant has been issued for:
     ~mission(Target1)
     ~mission(Target2)
     ~mission(Target3)

It is currently believed that they are no longer traveling together in order to evade capture, and may soon flee the system.  You should strongly consider recruiting additional help in order to execute all the warrants in the limited time frame. 

You are authorized to use whatever force is necessary to neutralize the targets. 

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract when all targets have been dealt with in the allotted time.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

PU_Bounty_PVE_Pyro_CFP_vs_XT_Idris_Event.label: PU_Bounty_PVE_Pyro_CFP_vs_XT_Idris_Event
PU_Bounty_PVE_Pyro_CFP_vs_XT_Idris_Event.title: Eliminate XenoThreat Idris
PU_Bounty_PVE_Pyro_CFP_vs_XT_Idris_Event.description:
Hey, 

The rumors are true. XenoThreat has deployed an Idris to stalk and attack Citizens for Prosperity operations in a dramatic escalation of their hostility towards us. We just received word the ship, under the command of ~mission(TargetName), is advancing toward ~mission(location|address). We can’t get our own forces there fast enough to fight them, and are in desperate need of help. 

We’re looking to hire someone brave enough to take it to these bastards. It’s not enough to scare them away, we need to guarantee that it can’t come after us again. 

Not sure if you’ve faced down an Idris before, but it’s a tall task for someone to take on alone. I’d highly recommend recruiting others to the cause.   

Best,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

PU_Bounty_PVE_Stanton3_BlacJac_Hard.label: PU_Bounty_PVE_Stanton3_BlacJac_Hard
PU_Bounty_PVE_Stanton3_BlacJac_Hard.title: Wanted by ArcCorp: ~mission(TargetName) (HRT)
PU_Bounty_PVE_Stanton3_BlacJac_Hard.description:
ATTN: Bounty Hunters

Your next bounty, ~mission(TargetName), is definitely considered a high-risk target for good reason. They’re known to travel with some serious firepower and are escorted by enough protection to make anyone think twice about picking a fight.

Sources indicate that ~mission(TargetName|Last) is hiding out over at ~mission(Location|Address). When you head out to track them down, just make sure you’re prepared. Might even think about bringing along some backup yourself.  

Thanks,
Gloria Mesa

Private Contract Supervisor
BlacJac Security, "Protection Provided"

PU_Bounty_PVE_Stanton3_BlacJac_Medium.label: PU_Bounty_PVE_Stanton3_BlacJac_Medium
PU_Bounty_PVE_Stanton3_BlacJac_Medium.title: Wanted by ArcCorp: ~mission(TargetName) (MRT)
PU_Bounty_PVE_Stanton3_BlacJac_Medium.description:
ATTN: Bounty Hunters

Need you to sort out ~mission(TargetName), a moderate-risk bounty last seen at ~mission(Location|Address) flying a small, multicrew ship. 

We weren’t able to get details on exactly what they were piloting, but it seems they did have a few other ships with them. Be ready for a fair bit of resistance when you come calling.

Thanks,
Gloria Mesa

Private Contract Supervisor
BlacJac Security, "Protection Provided"

PU_Bounty_PVE_Stanton3_BlacJac_VEasy.label: PU_Bounty_PVE_Stanton3_BlacJac_VEasy
PU_Bounty_PVE_Stanton3_BlacJac_VEasy.title: Wanted by ArcCorp: ~mission(TargetName) (VLRT)
PU_Bounty_PVE_Stanton3_BlacJac_VEasy.description:
ATTN: Bounty Hunters

Got a very low-risk target I need you to take care of: ~mission(TargetName).

Their last known location was ~mission(Location|Address).

This is a low threat bounty, so I expect you to be able to clear it pretty fast. They typically fly a small ship and don’t have very many known acquaintances. It doesn't get much more straightforward than that.

Thanks,
Gloria Mesa

Private Contract Supervisor
BlacJac Security, "Protection Provided"

PU_Bounty_PVE_Stanton3_BlacJac_VHard.label: PU_Bounty_PVE_Stanton3_BlacJac_VHard
PU_Bounty_PVE_Stanton3_BlacJac_VHard.title: Wanted by ArcCorp: ~mission(TargetName) (VHRT)
PU_Bounty_PVE_Stanton3_BlacJac_VHard.description:
ATTN: Bounty Hunters

BlacJac just got word that a very high-risk target, ~mission(TargetName), was spotted moving through the flight lanes over at ~mission(Location|Address) piloting a formidable ship with a heavy escort.  

We want this bounty closed out before they commit any more crimes. Gather whatever resources or support you need, and head out as soon as you can.

Thanks,
Gloria Mesa

Private Contract Supervisor
BlacJac Security, "Protection Provided"

PU_Bounty_PVE_Stanton3_BlacJac_Easy.label: PU_Bounty_PVE_Stanton3_BlacJac_Easy
PU_Bounty_PVE_Stanton3_BlacJac_Easy.title: Wanted by ArcCorp: ~mission(TargetName) (LRT)
PU_Bounty_PVE_Stanton3_BlacJac_Easy.description:
ATTN: Bounty Hunters

Bounty came in for a low-risk target by the name of ~mission(TargetName). The target themselves isn’t all that much to worry about, but it seems that they typically fly in a pack, so there’s a high chance they’ll have a few friends along when you track them down.

Speaking of, I’d start the hunt over at ~mission(Location|Address) since we have reports of them being spotted in the area.

Thanks,
Gloria Mesa

Private Contract Supervisor
BlacJac Security, "Protection Provided"

PU_Bounty_PVE_Stanton3_BlacJac_Super.label: PU_Bounty_PVE_Stanton3_BlacJac_Super
PU_Bounty_PVE_Stanton3_BlacJac_Super.title: Wanted by ArcCorp: ~mission(TargetName) (ERT)
PU_Bounty_PVE_Stanton3_BlacJac_Super.description:
ATTN: Bounty Hunters

You might have heard of ~mission(TargetName) before. They’re an extreme-risk target and they’ve been making headlines recently. The hope is you’ll be able to put together a response team and help BlacJac shut them down for good. Our most recent intel has their sub-capital ship and heavily armed escorts flying over at ~mission(Location|Address).
 
I’d recommend making sure you’ve got an up-to-date imprint before heading out. Just in case. 

Good luck,
Gloria Mesa

Private Contract Supervisor
BlacJac Security, "Protection Provided"

PU_Bounty_PVE_Stanton3_BlacJac_ReHiring.label: PU_Bounty_PVE_Stanton3_BlacJac_ReHiring
PU_Bounty_PVE_Stanton3_BlacJac_ReHiring.title: BlacJac Bounty Trial Contract
PU_Bounty_PVE_Stanton3_BlacJac_ReHiring.description:
ATTN: Former BlacJac Bounty Hunter

I know your last sting bounty hunting for BlacJac didn’t go well, but a soaring caseload means that you are lucky enough to get another chance.

If you're able to complete the bounty on ~mission(TargetName) over at ~mission(Location|Address) then we can see about getting you reinstated.

Thanks,
Gloria Mesa

Private Contract Supervisor
BlacJac Security, "Protection Provided"

PU_Bounty_PVE_Stanton3_BlacJac_Intro.label: PU_Bounty_PVE_Stanton3_BlacJac_Intro
PU_Bounty_PVE_Stanton3_BlacJac_Intro.title: BlacJac Bounty Trial Contract
PU_Bounty_PVE_Stanton3_BlacJac_Intro.description:
ATTN: Bounty Hunters

Not sure if you’re interested, but BlacJac is looking to expand our roster of bounty hunters. We got more jobs than our current contractors can handle, so I’m hoping that you might be able to help pick up some of the slack.  

Your qualifications look good on paper, but before we make anything official, BlacJac needs to see how you perform in the field firsthand. Even got a test case all lined up – we want you to sort out ~mission(TargetName). They were last seen at ~mission(Location|Address). Should be a fairly straightforward bounty without too much resistance. Perfect thing to sharpen your teeth on.

Good luck,
Gloria Mesa

Private Contract Supervisor
BlacJac Security, "Protection Provided"

PU_Bounty_PVE_Stanton_NorthRock_Intro.label: PU_Bounty_PVE_Stanton_NorthRock_Intro
PU_Bounty_PVE_Stanton_NorthRock_Intro.title: Pro Tem Bounty Contract
PU_Bounty_PVE_Stanton_NorthRock_Intro.description:
Hey,

Hope everything is going all right. I may have reached out to you already, but just in case, I wanted to message you again. I'm a logistics officer for the Stanton branch of Northrock Service Group, one of the top rated private security firms in the system, and we are looking to expand our portfolio of qualified contractors.

Now, even though you are certified by the Bounty Hunters Guild, Northrock will need you to complete a pro tem contract to make sure you're a good match. I'm thinking I'll start you off collecting the bounty on <EM4>~mission(TargetName)</EM4>. They were last seen at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>. 

Get that done and we'll see about getting you more work.

Hope to hear from you soon, 

Braden Corchado
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group

PU_Bounty_PVE_Stanton2_CruSec_Intro.description:
In an effort to increase the safety of Crusader and its environs, Crusader Security is seeking qualified individuals to assist with the collection of bounties in the area. 

We have evaluated that you possess the skill set needed and as such, we would like to offer you an initial trial bounty contract for ~mission(TargetName) last seen at ~mission(Location|Address). 

Upon the successful completion of this contract, you will be placed on Crusader's Verified Freelancer list and be eligible for any future bounty collection work as it becomes available.

Upon the successful completion of this trial, you'll be restored to Crusader's Verified Freelancer list and be eligible for any future bounty collection work as it becomes available.


CONTRACT AUTHORIZED BY:

PU_EliminateAll_Lawful_Stanton2_Floating.description:

Crusader Security is seeking a contractor willing to clear all Nine Tails operators in the area. Contractors should expect to use force and are strongly encouraged to consider bringing back-up. 

CONTRACT AUTHORIZED BY:
Liaison Officer Bautista
ID# 948J030K

PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_RoughAndReady.label: PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_RoughAndReady_Pyro3_Hard
PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_RoughAndReady.title: Stomp Spying Op
PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_RoughAndReady.description:
The Rough & Ready crew is looking for an independent merc interested in something heavy. We’ve been keeping an eye on a developing situation at ~mission(location|address) where ships are guarding several orbital sentries spying on our operations.      

Now, I might’ve been born at night, but it wasn’t last night. Considering the blatant way they’re set up, whoever’s responsible had to know we’d eventually discover it. Almost feels like they’re baiting R&R into attacking it, and I don’t want us falling for it. 

Instead, you’re gonna do it for us and get paid a damn good amount of creds for your effort. The ships stationed there will be less suspicious of an unaffiliated ship approaching and make it harder to pin the attack on us. 

Just be sure to plan accordingly before heading in. Maybe bring your own reinforcements in case any of their ships escape and call in some of their own.     

- Smokey

PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_RoughAndReady.label: PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_RoughAndReady_Pyro3_Medium
PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_RoughAndReady.title: Squash Spying Op
PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_RoughAndReady.description:
Recently made an interesting discovery that someone set up a handful of orbital sentries at ~mission(location|address). Guess they’re trying to grab some info about our operations there. They even have a few ships guarding to make sure nothing happens to them. 

Of course, we want these bastards gone, but I’m worried that getting rid of it ourselves would be bad for business. That’s why we’re looking for a little ‘plausible deniability’. Someone from outside of R&R to eliminate the problem, so whoever is behind it can’t directly tie the attack back to us. I know this won’t be a walk in the park, especially with those guards lurking. Who knows how many reinforcements they have at the ready? But if you manage to get it done, we’re prepared to see you paid right. 

Think you’ve got the skills to pull this off? 

- Smokey

PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_RoughAndReady.label: PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_RoughAndReady_Pyro3_Easy
PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_RoughAndReady.title: Silence Spying Op
PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_RoughAndReady.description:
The Rough & Ready crew is looking for someone to handle a delicate situation. We’ve discovered a ship and orbital sentries at ~mission(location|address) spyin’ on us. We’re in a bit of a bind because we don’t want to start a larger fight with whoever’s behind this. That’s why we’re looking for some hired help who can quickly and discreetly take care of it for us. Interested?

Last thing, once you’re out there, make sure to keep an eye on that ship. Bet as soon as you start blowin’ up their sentries they’re gonna try to bring in some help to stop you.
 
- Smokey

PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_HeadHunters_P.label: PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_HeadHunters_Pyro1_Hard
PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_HeadHunters_P.title: Exterminate Eavesdroppers
PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_HeadHunters_P.description:
Some idiots think they can blatantly spy on the Headhunters and get away with it. They’ve set up several orbital sentries at ~mission(location|address) and have a few ships patrolling the area. We don’t know who’s behind it but we honestly don’t care. We just need it gone. 

Let us know if you feel like putting some real brash bastards in their place. We’ll pay you well and deliver the creds the second the job is done. 

Keep in mind that it’s really only the sentries we care about. The ships they got patrolling are only a concern if they get in your way or if they try to call in some friends to stop you. 
 
Stows out.

PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_HeadHunters_P.label: PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_HeadHunters_Pyro1_Medium
PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_HeadHunters_P.title: Eradicate Eavesdroppers
PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_HeadHunters_P.description:
Headhunters are looking for a merc to do a little clean up for us. Found out that someone’s trying to spy on us over at ~mission(location|address). Can’t let that stand. We need a skilled operator to take care of the orbital sentries they dropped there, and if needed, deal with any of their ships that get in your way. Seems like a decently run op, so hitting it might not be easy but it sure should be fun. 

Let us know if you’re the right one for the gig. Creds will be transferred once our scans show it’s gone. 

Stows out.

PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_HeadHunters_P.label: PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_HeadHunters_Pyro1_Easy
PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_HeadHunters_P.title: Eliminate Eavesdroppers
PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_HeadHunters_P.description:
Some numbskull is trying to dig up dirt on the Headhunters. Some orbital sentries were dropped at ~mission(location|address) to spy on us. We’ve also spotted a ship checking on them. Simple proposition for you. Go wipe out the sentries there and we’ll pay you for it. That sound like something you’d be into?

As for the ship, you can do whatever you want with it, but if it spots you, don’t be surprised if it tries to go get some back up. That’s just how these things go.

Stows out.

PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_XenoThreat_Py.label: PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_XenoThreat_Pyro6_Easy
PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_XenoThreat_Py.title: Silence Sentries
PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_XenoThreat_Py.description:
Our resistance movement is growing by the day, but that comes with some unwanted attention.  Recent scans discovered orbital sentries at ~mission(location|address) and a ship running a patrol pattern. We believe this is part of an espionage campaign targeting XenoThreat, most likely funded by the UEE. 

We’re looking for an experienced merc willing to destroy the sentries ASAP.  Since they already have eyes and ears on us, sending in someone from outside the org would draw less attention. If you take the gig, you’ll be paid promptly once the sentries are destroyed.
 
Now, while the patrol ship isn’t the main target, we suspect that if it escapes it might have reinforcements in reserve. Might be smart to deal with it promptly. 

If you decide to help us, XenoThreat will remember you’re someone willing to fight for what’s right.

Comm. Spec. Engler

PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_XenoThreat_Py.label: PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_XenoThreat_Pyro6_Medium
PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_XenoThreat_Py.title: Eradicate Sentries
PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_XenoThreat_Py.description:
Do you value Humanity’s freedom? If so, I’m offering you a chance to prove it. Recent scans discovered orbital sentries and patrolling ships at ~mission(location|address). We believe they’re part of a UEE espionage campaign targeting XenoThreat. It’s important that we stop their intelligence gathering before we launch our next mission.

We’re looking for an experienced merc willing to eliminate these forces immediately. The sentries are the priority, but the ships might prove a bigger issue if they’re allowed to escape. You’ll have to evaluate the situation more closely once you’re on site. 

We could take care of it ourselves, but want to send in a contractor so the scum behind it don’t know who hit them. Payment will be sent promptly upon completion. Plus, the satisfaction of knowing you’re helping a good cause.

Comm. Spec. Engler

PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_XenoThreat_Py.label: PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_XenoThreat_Pyro6_Hard
PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_XenoThreat_Py.title: Annihilate Sentries
PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_XenoThreat_Py.description:
Recent scans discovered several orbital sentries and ships at ~mission(location|address). We believe they’re part of an espionage campaign targeting XenoThreat, in response to our recent actions in the Stanton system. Seems XenoThreat must be doing something right, if they’re out here spying like this.

We’re looking for an experienced and highly-skilled merc willing to eliminate this operation. If you don’t want Pyro to become a surveillance system, then this is your chance to stop it. The sentries probably won’t be too big of an issue, but pay mind to the patrol ships. If they manage to break away, you’ll have a whole lot more trouble breathing down your neck. 

You’ll have our gratitude and a sizable payment once the job is done. 

Comm. Spec. Engler

PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_XenoThreat_Py.description:
Our resistance movement is growing by the day, but that comes with some unwanted attention.  Recent scans discovered orbital sentries at ~mission(location|address) and a ship running a patrol pattern. We believe this is part of an espionage campaign targeting XenoThreat, most likely funded by the UEE. 

We’re looking for an experienced merc willing to destroy the sentries ASAP.  Since they already have eyes and ears on us, sending in someone from outside the org would draw less attention. If you take the gig, you’ll be paid promptly once the sentries are destroyed.
 
Now, while the patrol ship isn’t the main target, we suspect that if it escapes it might have reinforcements in reserve. Might be smart to deal with it promptly. 

If you decide to help us, XenoThreat will remember you’re someone willing to fight for what’s right.

Comm. Spec. Engler

Comm. Spec. Engler

PU_MissingPerson_Cave_Pyro_CFP_Danger.title: Missing: ~mission(TargetName)
PU_MissingPerson_Cave_Pyro_CFP_Danger.description:
We’ve been trying to get in contact with community member ~mission(TargetName), but haven’t heard from them in a few days. From what Citizens for Prosperity has been able to find out, they were scouting out near ~mission(Location|Address) which is a known outlaw hotspot.

We need someone to go there for us and try to locate them, or worst case scenario, their remains. 

If you are able to find them, there’s a reward on offer.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

PU_MissingPerson_Cave_Pyro_CFP_NoDanger.label: PU_MissingPerson_Cave_Pyro_CFP_NoDanger
PU_MissingPerson_Cave_Pyro_CFP_NoDanger.title: Missing: ~mission(TargetName)
PU_MissingPerson_Cave_Pyro_CFP_NoDanger.description:
~mission(TargetName) is a local who only has done a few jobs for Citizen for Prosperity, but they had promise. That is, until they went missing while exploring ~mission(Location|Address) last week. Unfortunately, we didn’t hear about it until today. Chances of survival at this point are pretty slim, but we still think its worth confirming what happened to them.
 
CFP could use help on this if anyone is interested. And besides being a good deed, the payment should make it worth the effort. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

PU_MissingPerson_DistributionCentres_Sta.label: PU_MissingPerson_DistributionCentres_Stanton4_CovalexS4DC05
PU_MissingPerson_DistributionCentres_Sta.title: ~mission(TargetName) Reported Missing
PU_MissingPerson_DistributionCentres_Sta.description:
ABOUT THE JOB
After receiving a report that ~mission(TargetName) has been missing, microTech Protection Services is seeking a qualified contractor to begin an onsite search of ~mission(Location|Address) to learn their current whereabouts. The missing individual was last seen entering the ~mission(Location) so it's recommended to begin the search there.

RESPONSIBILITIES
• Provide own transportation to ~mission(Location|address).
• Confirm the location of ~mission(TargetName) and if they are still alive.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
• 2 years security experience.
• Available for immediate deployment.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
• Experience with conducting missing person investigations.

PU_MissingPerson_DistributionCentres_Sta.label: PU_MissingPerson_DistributionCentres_Stanton4_MTS4LD13
PU_MissingPerson_DistributionCentres_Sta.title: ~mission(TargetName) Whereabouts Unknown
PU_MissingPerson_DistributionCentres_Sta.description:
ABOUT THE JOB
microTech Protection Services is seeking a qualified contractor to assist in the search for ~mission(TargetName) who was last seen near the ~mission(Location) at ~mission(Location|Address) but who's current whereabouts are unknown. 

Our preliminary investigation has led us to suspect foul play may be behind their disappearance. As such, heightened caution is advised as there may be hostile actors involved.

RESPONSIBILITIES
• Provide own transportation to ~mission(Location|address).
• Confirm the location of ~mission(TargetName) and if they are still alive.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
• 2 years security experience.
• Available for immediate deployment.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
• Experience with conducting missing person investigations.
• Ability to handle high pressure situations.

PU_MissingPerson_DistributionCentres_Sta.label: PU_MissingPerson_DistributionCentres_Stanton1_Magnolia
PU_MissingPerson_DistributionCentres_Sta.title: Missing Person Report: ~mission(TargetName)
PU_MissingPerson_DistributionCentres_Sta.description:
HURSTON DYNAMICS OUTSOURCING
CONTRACT: Locate Missing Individual
OUTSOURCE MANAGER: I. Takao
RISK ASSESSMENT: Low

The staff at ~mission(Location|Address) has recently filed a missing persons report for one ~mission(TargetName). They have been missing for several days and were last seen heading to the ~mission(Location).

You are being contracted to conduct an onsite search for ~mission(TargetName|Last) and see if you can determine their whereabouts. 

Payment is dependent on returning a record of their current location, alive or dead.




** The information transmitted may contain confidential and/or privileged material. Any review, retransmission, dissemination or other use of or taking action in reliance upon this information by persons or entities other than the intended recipient is prohibited. **

PU_MissingPerson_DerelictOutpost_Pyro_CF.title: Missing: ~mission(TargetName)
PU_MissingPerson_DerelictOutpost_Pyro_CF.description:
One of our people, ~mission(TargetName), was supposed to be doing some preliminary scouting work over at ~mission(Location|Address), but they never reported in. We’re hoping that they just ran into some bad luck, but too often out here even the smallest misstep can prove fatal.

I’d appreciate someone heading that way and seeing if they can be located. It’d be great if you find them alive, but if not, some closure is the least we can do for their family.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

PU_MissingPerson_DerelictOutpost_Pyro_CF.label: PU_MissingPerson_DerelictOutpost_Pyro_CFP_Danger
PU_MissingPerson_DerelictOutpost_Pyro_CF.title: Missing: ~mission(TargetName)
PU_MissingPerson_DerelictOutpost_Pyro_CF.description:
Unfortunately, one of our community partners, ~mission(TargetName), has been missing for a few days. Their family contacted Citizens for Prosperity for help and I told them we would do what we could. That said, with so much time passed, I’m not too hopeful.

Whatever their current state is, we're looking for someone to be our eyes on the ground for this one. There’s a strong chance that they were headed to ~mission(Location|Address), an area known to be very dangerous.

If you can track them down and confirm their status, one way or another, I’ll see that you’re properly compensated.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

PU_MissingPerson_Pyro_RR_Pyro2_Danger.label: PU_MissingPerson_Pyro_RR_Pyro2_Danger
PU_MissingPerson_Pyro_RR_Pyro2_Danger.title: ~mission(TargetName) Gone Missing
PU_MissingPerson_Pyro_RR_Pyro2_Danger.description:
After hearing rumors that we might’ve gotten a bad case of squatters over at ~mission(Location|Address), I had sent one of my more trusted people to investigate. 

Bad news is that I haven’t heard from them since. 

I’d like for you to head over and see if you can find ~mission(TargetName)’s current whereabouts.  I’ll leave it up to you how you want to deal with any scum you come across. 

Confirm where ~mission(TargetName|Last) is, and there’ll be a reward in it for you.

- Smokey

PU_MissingPerson_Stations_Pyro_CFP_Pyro1.title: Missing: ~mission(TargetName)
PU_MissingPerson_Stations_Pyro_CFP_Pyro1.description:
Hey,

I’m getting pretty worried about one of our local contractors, ~mission(TargetName). They finished up a trade at ~mission(Location|Address) and haven’t been seen since. We’re hearing reports that outlaws have been sneaking aboard there, and if that’s true, I suspect that the worst might have happened.

Either way, ~mission(TargetName|First) has done good work for us in the past and I’d hate for them to wind up as just another one of Pyro’s missing. If you’re willing to find them for me, I’ll see that you get a reward. 

Just be careful. Hate for you to go missing too.

Thanks,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

PU_TripMinesTheft_DC_Stanton_SecPed_micr.label: PU_TripMinesTheft_DC_Stanton_SecPed_microTech-S4LD13
PU_TripMinesTheft_DC_Stanton_SecPed_micr.title: Delicate Dealings
PU_TripMinesTheft_DC_Stanton_SecPed_micr.description:
I’m really hoping you’re going to agree to do this since there doesn’t seem to be too many folks eager to take on a whole bunch of proximity mines. See, there’s a score that we’ve sourced at ~mission(Location|Address) but the physical security is proving more difficult than expected. 

If you can find a way to navigate through the mines or possibly a way to trigger them remotely, it should be relatively easy to grab the goods and make your way out of there. Drop them off at ~mission(Destination|Address) and you’ll get more than your fair cut of the credits for taking on the risk.

-Bit Zeros

PU_TripMinesTheft_DC_Stanton_SecPed_Aban.label: PU_TripMinesTheft_DC_Stanton_SecPed_Abandoned-Dupree
PU_TripMinesTheft_DC_Stanton_SecPed_Aban.title: Dangerous Take
PU_TripMinesTheft_DC_Stanton_SecPed_Aban.description:
I was hopin’ you’d be interested in pulling a little job for us. Got some goods over at ~mission(Location|Address) that are just right for the taking. Only problem is – and it’s a big one – the bastards running the place have the whole area rigged with proximity mines. 

You’ll need to find someway through, or if you can’t be bothered, someway to trigger the lot. Either way, just try not to blow yourself up. Then you just need to grab the stuff and take it over to ~mission(Destination|Address).

It won’t be easy to pull off, but if you do, I promise I’ll make it worth your while.

PU_EliminateBoss_Lawful_Stanton2_Floatin.label: PU_EliminateBoss_Lawful_Stanton2_FloatingPlatform
PU_EliminateBoss_Lawful_Stanton2_Floatin.title: Nine Tails Enforcer Bounty (HRT)
PU_EliminateBoss_Lawful_Stanton2_Floatin.description:
Crusader Security has received intelligence that a Nine Tails raid currently occurring at ~mission(MissionCluster|Address) includes a prominent gang enforcer. Ending this raid and bringing those responsible to justice is a top priority for Crusader Security. That's why we're looking for a contractor willing to go to ~mission(MissionCluster|Name) to stop the threat and apprehend the enforcer leading it.

Once on site, you will need to deplete the Nine Tails forces until you are able to draw out ~mission(TargetName).

Considering the brutality deployed by Nine Tails during their recent siege, we recommend that contractors be prepared to use force and strongly encourage them to consider bringing back-up.

CONTRACT AUTHORIZED BY:
Liaison Officer Gibbs
ID# 91G66BW0

PU_RetrieveConsignment_Pyro_CFP_Pyro6_Ea.label: PU_RetrieveConsignment_Pyro_CFP_Pyro6_Easy
PU_RetrieveConsignment_Pyro_CFP_Pyro6_Ea.title: Confidential Material Stolen
PU_RetrieveConsignment_Pyro_CFP_Pyro6_Ea.description:
You available for a job? One of our secure locations got hit by outlaws and some highly confidential material was stolen. As you can imagine, Citizens for Prosperity is eager to recover them as soon as possible.

Thanks to a local contact, we were able to trace the outlaws back to ~mission(Location|Address) where they're storing the confidential materials inside a secure automated vault. To access it, you’ll need to first find the relevant retrieval code and enter it at the vault’s package conveyor. Our best guess is that one of outlaw leaders will be carrying the code on their person so there is a very strong chance you’ll have to engage with them directly to get it.
  
Once you’ve gotten possession of the confidential material, we want you to deliver it to ~mission(Dropoff1|Address).

You’ll be making a big difference to a lot of people if you manage to pull this off.

Thanks in advance,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

PU_EliminateSpecific_Lawful_Stanton1c_Sa.title: Entrenched Bounty: ~mission(TargetName) (MRT)
PU_EliminateSpecific_Lawful_Stanton1c_Sa.description:
HURSTON DYNAMICS
OUTSOURCING DEPARTMENT

CONTRACT: Bounty Collection
CONTRACTOR AFFILIATION: Independent
OUTSOURCE MANAGER: I. Takao
RISK ASSESSMENT: Moderate Risk Target (Likely Armed Support)
RUSH CONTRACT: No

Hurston Dynamics is seeking a contractor to complete a bounty for ~mission(TargetName). 

Intel reports have tracked the  target to ~mission(Location|Address).  This site is known to be frequented by criminals who are most likely armed and hostile. Engage with them as you see fit, but your top priority is the neutralization of ~mission(TargetName|Last).

Payment will be released only after the bounty has been deemed complete.
 

** The information transmitted may contain confidential and/or privileged material. Any review, retransmission, dissemination or other use of or taking action in reliance upon this information by persons or entities other than the intended recipient is prohibited. **

ABOUT THE JOB
While your past performance has not been to our standards, microTech Protection Services has decided to offer you a chance to redeem yourself. 

To reevaluate your skills, we would like you to apprehend ~mission(TargetName) from ~mission(Location|Address).

While there will be other criminals at the site, your main focus should be on completing the bounty.

• Provide own transportation to ~mission(Location|Address).
• Neutralize ~mission(TargetName); using force as necessary.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
• Bounty Hunters Guild membership and appropriate certification.
• Access to combat equipment and mode of transport.
• Available for immediate deployment.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
• Ability to handle high pressure situations.

PU_Inhabited_Derelict_EliminateAll_Lawfu.label: PU_Inhabited_Derelict_EliminateAll_Lawful_Standard_Stanton2b
PU_Inhabited_Derelict_EliminateAll_Lawfu.title: Clear Criminal Nest
PU_Inhabited_Derelict_EliminateAll_Lawfu.description:
Crusader Security has learned that ~mission(Location|Address) is currently being used as a base of operations for numerous illegal activities.

In order to put a stop to this "nest of criminals," we are seeking a contractor to go to the site and clear all the occupants. By force if necessary.

CONTRACT AUTHORIZED BY:
Liaison Officer Bautista
ID# 948J030K

PU_Inhabited_Derelict_Recover_Stash_Lawf.label: PU_Inhabited_Derelict_Recover_Stash_Lawful_Standard_Stanton2b
PU_Inhabited_Derelict_Recover_Stash_Lawf.title: Retrieval Op
PU_Inhabited_Derelict_Recover_Stash_Lawf.description:
Here's the deal – a client of ours (who should have spent the extra credits for a Northrock escort) had one of their ships attacked and now they need us to run point on a retrieval op for an important package that was stolen.

Thankfully, we caught a break and were able to track down the people responsible to <EM4>~mission(Pickup1|Address)</EM4>. We need you to head there and recover the package. You'll be able to ID it by its serial number: <EM4>#~mission(Item1|SerialNumber)</EM4>.

I expect that the outlaws are going to put up a fight, but just remember that they aren't the priority.

Once you got the package, fly it back to the client at <EM4>~mission(Dropoff1|Address)</EM4>. 

One last thing, make sure you bring a ship that has enough room for some cargo. Don't want you getting all the way there in your Gladius or whatever only to have to turn back.

Do us proud,

Braden Corchado
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group

*RETRIEVAL OPERATION SUMMARY*
* Recover Package <EM4>#~mission(Item1|SerialNumber)</EM4> from <EM4>~mission(Pickup1|Address)</EM4>
* Deliver to <EM4>~mission(Dropoff1|Address)</EM4>

PU_Destroy_Items_Stanton_DC_Stanton4_mic.label: PU_Destroy_Items_Stanton_DC_Stanton4_microTech-S4LD13_SidePed
PU_Destroy_Items_Stanton_DC_Stanton4_mic.title: Hit 'Em Where it Hurts
PU_Destroy_Items_Stanton_DC_Stanton4_mic.description:
The muckers over at ~mission(Location|Address) decided that it would be a good idea to interfere with our business, and now we need to let them know unequivocally that they were mistaken. 

A little bit of sniffin’ through their data and we were able to sus out where the idiots keep their stash. Now all we need you to do is head over there and destroy every last bit of it. 

Figure that should drive the point home.

- Bit Zeros

PU_Destroy_Items_Stanton_DC_Stanton4_Cry.label: PU_Destroy_Items_Stanton_DC_Stanton4_CryAstroPlant34-12_Refinery
PU_Destroy_Items_Stanton_DC_Stanton4_Cry.title: Major Malfunction
PU_Destroy_Items_Stanton_DC_Stanton4_Cry.description:
I won’t go into the whole long boring story of why, but there are a few bits of ~mission(Location|Address) that we need destroyed. The important part is that I want to pay you a hefty chunk of credits to do it. I almost feel like you should be paying us for this because of how fun it’s going to be.

Don’t even care how you get it done. Grenades, rocket launcher, day old Torpedo Burrito, it’s all the same to us.

-Bit Zeros

PU_Destroy_Items_Stanton_DC_Stanton1_Aba.label: PU_Destroy_Items_Stanton_DC_Stanton1_Abandoned-Dupree_SidePed
PU_Destroy_Items_Stanton_DC_Stanton1_Aba.title: Demolition Mission
PU_Destroy_Items_Stanton_DC_Stanton1_Aba.description:
I’m looking to send a strong message to the crew over at ~mission(Location|Address) and know the perfect way to do it - property damage.

All you need to do is head on over, destroy a few things here and there, and really drive home an important lesson about respecting your betters. 

Do that for me and I’ll be feeling very happy. And generous.

Interested?

PU_EliminateAll_Stations_Hatch_Pyro_RR_E.label: PU_EliminateAll_Stations_Hatch_Pyro_RR_Easy
PU_EliminateAll_Stations_Hatch_Pyro_RR_E.title: Extermination Job
PU_EliminateAll_Stations_Hatch_Pyro_RR_E.description:
Rough & Ready has a rat problem. One of our crews tried to pull a little mutiny and now they’ve taken over ~mission(location|address).

Since I can’t be 100% sure they don’t have sympathizers onboard the station, I want you to handle putting down these traitors for me.

If you can clear out our little pest issue you’ll be paid handsomely. Just don’t leave a single one of them alive. Don’t want anyone else getting funny ideas.

- Smokey

PU_EliminateAll_Stations_Hangar_Pyro_RR_.label: PU_EliminateAll_Stations_Hangar_Pyro_RR_Easy
PU_EliminateAll_Stations_Hangar_Pyro_RR_.title: Unwanted Guests
PU_EliminateAll_Stations_Hangar_Pyro_RR_.description:
We got some outlaws overstaying their welcome on one of our stations. They tried to pull a fast one on us but now they’re trapped in ~mission(location|address). We need you to clear ‘em out. 

Rough & Ready doesn’t want a single one of them left alive when you’re through. Don’t care how messy it gets as long as it gets done, got it?

- Smokey

PU_Inhabited_Derelict_EliminateSpecific_.description:
Thanks to a recent arrest, we have learned the location of an active bounty by the name of ~mission(TargetName). They are currently believed to be holed up at ~mission(Location|Address). You have been authorized to enter the site, find them, and resolve the bounty.

We have every reason to believe that there will be other criminal elements at the site, but for the moment, only ~mission(TargetName|Last) is your concern. 

CONTRACT AUTHORIZED BY:
Liaison Officer Gibbs
ID# 91G66BW0

PU_Derelict_EliminateSpecific_Lawful_Sta.description:
ABOUT THE JOB
microTech Protection Services is looking for a qualified bounty hunter to apprehend ~mission(TargetName) from ~mission(Location|Address). 

While there will be other criminals at the site, your main focus should be on completing the bounty.

RESPONSIBILITIES
• Provide own transportation to ~mission(Location|Address).
• Neutralize ~mission(TargetName); using force as necessary.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
• Bounty Hunters Guild membership and appropriate certification.
• Access to combat equipment and mode of transport.
• Available for immediate deployment.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
• Ability to handle high pressure situations.

Gloria Mesa

CONTRACTOR AFFILIATION: Independent
OUTSOURCE MANAGER: ~mission(Contractor|Auth)
RISK ASSESSMENT: Moderate Risk Target (Possible Armed Support)
RUSH CONTRACT: ~mission(Contractor|BountyTimed)

Under the authority of Hurston Dynamics as granted by the UEE, a bounty has been issued for ~mission(TargetName) relating to crimes against the corporation. 

The subject is believed to be recently located at ~mission(Location|Address), potentially with several allies. Force may be required to gain access to the site and neutralize ~mission(TargetName|Last). ~mission(Location|CaveSize)

Payment will be released only after the bounty has been deemed complete.
 

** The information transmitted may contain confidential and/or privileged material. Any review, retransmission, dissemination or other use of or taking action in reliance upon this information by persons or entities other than the intended recipient is prohibited. **

PU_Derelict_EliminateAll_Lawful_Stanton2.label: PU_Derelict_EliminateAll_Lawful_Stanton2c
PU_Derelict_EliminateAll_Lawful_Stanton2.title: ~mission(Contractor|BaseSweepTitle)
PU_Derelict_EliminateAll_Lawful_Stanton2.description:
Crusader Security has learned that ~mission(Location|Address) is currently being used as a base of operations for numerous illegal activities.

In order to put a stop to this "nest of criminals," we are seeking a contractor to go to the site and clear all the occupants. By force if necessary.

CONTRACT AUTHORIZED BY:
Liaison Officer Bautista
ID# 948J030K

PU_Theft_Station_Pyro_XT_vs_RR.label: PU_Theft_Station_Pyro_XT_vs_RR
PU_Theft_Station_Pyro_XT_vs_RR.title: Price of Business
PU_Theft_Station_Pyro_XT_vs_RR.description:
Not sure if you’d had the pleasure of dealing with the Rough & Ready, but the gang is laser focused on cornering the fuel market in Pyro. Smart play, but one we can’t let happen without them providing us some concessions. Since they’re currently not interested in negotiating, we’re forced to show them what happens to those who oppose us.

We’ve identified ~mission(Pickup1|Address) as a prime target for such an attack. We also know they recently received some supplies that should be a fitting price for their obstinance. Once inside the station, do whatever you need to do to confiscate the ~mission(item). We’ll send payment once you’ve delivered them to ~mission(Dropoff1|Address).      

Comm. Spec. Engler

PU_Theft_Station_Pyro_XT_vs_CFP.label: PU_Theft_Station_Pyro_XT_vs_CFP
PU_Theft_Station_Pyro_XT_vs_CFP.title: Agent of Chaos
PU_Theft_Station_Pyro_XT_vs_CFP.description:
Citizens for Prosperity have entrenched themselves at ~mission(Pickup1|Address). To keep them from getting too comfy at that station, we want to show them what life is really like in our system. We’ll pay you to hit the station, grab the ~mission(item), and kill anyone that gets in your way. 

Payment hinges on you delivering those supplies to ~mission(Dropoff1|Address). Anyone you kill will just be a perk.     

Comm. Spec. Engler

PU_Theft_Outpost_Pyro_XT_vs_HH.label: PU_Theft_Outpost_Pyro_XT_vs_HH
PU_Theft_Outpost_Pyro_XT_vs_HH.title: Repossess Supplies
PU_Theft_Outpost_Pyro_XT_vs_HH.description:
As much as XenoThreat has strived to make Pyro a pure haven for Humans, not everyone is aligned with our goals. Chief among them is the Headhunters, who have debased themselves by hiring an alien hauler to deliver supplies to them. We missed the chance to hit that shipment, but still want to send the message that working with aliens in any capacity will not be tolerated in this system. 

That shipment was delivered to ~mission(Pickup1|Address). We want someone to hit the outpost, claim the ~mission(item), and take it to ~mission(Dropoff1|Address) so we can properly dispose of it. 

You up for keeping Pyro free from alien influence?

Comm. Spec. Engler

PU_Theft_Outpost_Pyro_XT_vs_CFP.label: PU_Theft_Outpost_Pyro_XT_vs_CFP
PU_Theft_Outpost_Pyro_XT_vs_CFP.title: Steal Subsidies
PU_Theft_Outpost_Pyro_XT_vs_CFP.description:
Leave it to the lying UEE to say they’re not involved with the operations of Citizens for Prosperity simply because they “donate” supplies to a tertiary aid organization who then immediately delivers it right to them. 

We just got word that one of these government aid shipments was dropped off at a Citizens for Prosperity aligned outpost. That’s why we’ll pay you to raid ~mission(Pickup1|Address) and claim the ~mission(item) for the cause. Once you deliver everything to ~mission(Dropoff1|Address) we can redistribute the shipment to help in our fight. Nothing better than using the enemies resources against them. 

But don’t think they’ll just hand the stuff over to you. Even though Citizens for Prosperity are supposedly here to bring peace, you best be prepared to go toe to toe with ‘em. 

Comm. Spec. Engler

PU_Theft_Outpost_Pyro_CFP_vs_GenericOutl.label: PU_Theft_Outpost_Pyro_CFP_vs_GenericOutlaw_Pyro1
PU_Theft_Outpost_Pyro_CFP_vs_GenericOutl.title: Stolen Supplies
PU_Theft_Outpost_Pyro_CFP_vs_GenericOutl.description:
Hey,

We could use your help.

A local we work with was completing a delivery for us, but unfortunately, she ran into some outlaws and had to surrender her ~mission(Item). Silver lining is the outlaws didn’t notice the trackers we placed in the cargo and now we know they’ve taken their haul to ~mission(Location|Address). 

We’d like you to recover the packages for us and finish delivering them to ~mission(Destination|Address). I don’t imagine the outlaws will give them up willingly, but I wouldn’t ask you to put yourself in harm’s way if these supplies weren’t of critical importance.

Also, to make your life easier, I'd suggest you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. 

So, what do you say?

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

PU_Theft_DC_Stanton_Stor_CryAstro_PP19-0.title: Ownership Reassignment
PU_Theft_DC_Stanton_Stor_CryAstro_PP19-0.description:
All right,

Over at ~mission(Location|Address) there a few certain things they have in their possession that need to be liberated. Sure there may be a few guards or concerned individuals you’ll have to deal with, but for the most part it’s a relatively straight forward transaction – grab the stuff from the ~mission(Location) and take it to us at ~mission(Destination|Address). 

Sometimes simple is best.

-Bit Zeros

PU_PVP_Bounty_Stanton_NorthRock_General_.label: PU_PVP_Bounty_Stanton_NorthRock_General_ReHiring
PU_PVP_Bounty_Stanton_NorthRock_General_.title: Pro Tem Suspect Apprehension (Reevaluation)
PU_PVP_Bounty_Stanton_NorthRock_General_.description:
Hey again,

It's been a little while, hope everything's okay. I know things didn't end on the best terms, but after discussing it with management, I would like to offer you an opportunity to redeem yourself. You had potential and I hate to think that you didn't have a proper chance to show what you're capable of.

Apprehend <EM4>~mission(TargetName)</EM4> and we can see about getting your employment status reinstated.

Braden Corchado
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group

PU_PVP_Bounty_Stanton_NorthRock_General_.label: PU_PVP_Bounty_Stanton_NorthRock_General_Intro
PU_PVP_Bounty_Stanton_NorthRock_General_.title: Pro Tem Suspect Apprehension
PU_PVP_Bounty_Stanton_NorthRock_General_.description:
Hi,

Hope you don't mind, but I was made aware of your Bounty Hunters Guild status and wanted to reach out and see if you'd be interested in contracting with Northrock Service Group, one of the top rated private security firms in the system.

If you are, the first step would be to complete a pro tem suspect apprehension. It's less of an evaluation and more of a chance to make sure that we can have a good working relationship. 

The suspect you would be after is known as <EM4>~mission(TargetName)</EM4>. They are known to be particularly elusive so you may have your work cut out for you.

Hope to hear from you soon, 

Braden Corchado
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group

PU_PVP_Bounty_Stanton_NorthRock_PrisonEs.label: PU_PVP_Bounty_Stanton_NorthRock_PrisonEscapee_Intro
PU_PVP_Bounty_Stanton_NorthRock_PrisonEs.title: Pro Tem Escapee Bounty Contract
PU_PVP_Bounty_Stanton_NorthRock_PrisonEs.description:
Hey There,

My name is Braden Corchado and I'm a logistics officer for Northrock Service Group, the leading independently-owned security firm operating in the Stanton system. I may have reached out already, but we try to make it a point of approaching anyone who meets our high standards and encouraging them to complete a pro tem contract. 

You can't do much better than become a Northrock contractor. We have a solid reputation for offering challenging and interesting work at a higher rate of pay then many of our competitors in system. 

Now, to get approved, you will need to apprehend one ~mission(TargetName). They have recently escaped from the detention center and your job will be to track them down before they can disappear completely off the grid. 

A little hint is that it's safe to assume that the target is going to go try to clear their record. I recommend triangulating your search between the detention center they escaped from and locations where they can hack into the record system.

Get this done and we'll see about getting you more work.

Hope to hear from you soon, 

Braden Corchado
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group

PU_PVP_Bounty_Stanton_NorthRock_PrisonEs.label: PU_PVP_Bounty_Stanton_NorthRock_PrisonEscapee_ReHiring
PU_PVP_Bounty_Stanton_NorthRock_PrisonEs.title: Pro Tem Escapee Bounty Contract (Reevaluation)
PU_PVP_Bounty_Stanton_NorthRock_PrisonEs.description:
Hey,

I know it's been a little while, but if you are still interested in doing contract work for Northrock, I convinced the management to give you a reevaluation. If you can successfully complete a bounty for us, we can see about getting your employment status reinstated.

This pro tem contract is to track down escaped criminal ~mission(TargetName). Try your best to get to them before they can wipe their record at database access point or the job's going to be significantly more difficult.

Hoping we can trust you on this.
 
Braden Corchado
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group

PU_Bounty_PVE_Group_NorthRock_Intro_Stan.label: PU_Bounty_PVE_Group_NorthRock_Intro_Stanton1
PU_Bounty_PVE_Group_NorthRock_Intro_Stan.title: Pro Tem Group Warrant Contract
PU_Bounty_PVE_Group_NorthRock_Intro_Stan.description:
Hey,

Hope everything is going all right. I may have reached out already, but I wanted to be sure and introduce myself. I'm a logistics officer for Northrock Service Group, the leading independently-owned security firm operating in the Stanton system today, providing a variety of services to all major governmental bodies as well as various private concerns. The reason I am contacting you is because we believe someone with your skills could be a boon to our clients. 

Not only that, but I think we'd be good fit for you. Our contractors traditionally get a higher rate of pay than a lot of our competitors in system, and a lot of them tell me how they really enjoy being tasked with the challenging and interesting work we offer. 

Now, Northrock holds itself to such high-standards so before we can make anything official, you'll need to achieve approved contractor status by completing a pro tem contract. 

I was hoping you could capture several wanted members of an outlaw gang: ~mission(Target1), ~mission(Target2), and ~mission(Target3).

Get that done and we'll see about getting you more work.

Hope to hear from you soon, 

Braden Corchado
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group

PU_Bounty_PVE_Group_Stanton1_Eckhart_Har.title: Group Warrant Issued
PU_Bounty_PVE_Group_Stanton1_Eckhart_Har.description:

CONTRACTOR STATUS: Independent
Approval code: = ~mission(Contractor|ApprovalCode)

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

In relation to a jointly committed crime, a group warrant has been issued for:
     ~mission(Target1)
     ~mission(Target2)
     ~mission(Target3)

It is currently believed that they are no longer traveling together in order to evade capture, and may soon flee the system.  You should strongly consider recruiting additional help in order to execute all the warrants in the limited time frame. 

You are authorized to use whatever force is necessary to neutralize the targets. 

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract when all targets have been dealt with in the allotted time.

This contract is non-negotiable.

PU_MissingPerson_Cave_Pyro_CFP_Danger_Py.description:
We’ve been trying to get in contact with community member ~mission(TargetName), but haven’t heard from them in a few days. From what Citizens for Prosperity has been able to find out, they were scouting out near ~mission(Location|Address) which is a known outlaw hotspot.

We need someone to go there for us and try to locate them, or worst case scenario, their remains. 

If you are able to find them, there’s a reward on offer.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

PU_MissingPerson_DistributionCentres_Sta.title: ~mission(TargetName) Whereabouts Unknown
PU_MissingPerson_DistributionCentres_Sta.description:
ABOUT THE JOB
microTech Protection Services is seeking a qualified contractor to assist in the search for ~mission(TargetName) who was last seen near the ~mission(Location) at ~mission(Location|Address) but who's current whereabouts are unknown. 

Our preliminary investigation has led us to suspect foul play may be behind their disappearance. As such, heightened caution is advised as there may be hostile actors involved.

RESPONSIBILITIES
• Provide own transportation to ~mission(Location|address).
• Confirm the location of ~mission(TargetName) and if they are still alive.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
• 2 years security experience.
• Available for immediate deployment.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
• Experience with conducting missing person investigations.
• Ability to handle high pressure situations.
